| Before tonight's stories The Supreme Court takes up semi-auto bans in December. Illinois is on the front line. This December the U.S. Supreme Court will hear arguments over whether the government can ban modern semiautomatic rifles, the most popular rifles in America, owned by millions of law-abiding citizens. A decision is expected by June.Illinois gun owners already live under one of those bans. The Illinois State Rifle Association is a named plaintiff challenging it. A federal judge struck the Illinois ban down as unconstitutional in December 2024, and the state has kept it alive on appeal ever since. ISRA is in court on several more fronts too: the suppressor ban, the rights of 18-to-20-year-olds, and FOID card delays.Fighting the left in court takes cash, and ISRA needs help. Whatever the Supreme Court decides will set the rules for every state. Lose, and an assault weapons ban can come to a state near you.On the donation form, choose "ISRA Legal Assistance Committee." That is ISRA's 501(c)(3) legal fund, and gifts to it may be tax-deductible. | | | | | | **Team Mackenzie,** I’m proud to represent the Greater Lehigh Valley in Washington and to work across the aisle to get things done for our community.I’m a Republican, but I don’t believe Washington’s partisan gridlock should stand in the way of finding common ground and delivering results. That’s why I’ve worked with Democrats and Republicans on issues that matter to people here at home – from cracking down on fraud and reforming congressional stock trading, to lowering prescription drug costs and supporting working families.And I’ve never forgotten where I come from. I’ve worked successfully to bring federal resources back to the Greater Lehigh Valley for infrastructure, public safety, first responders, job creation, and other projects that directly benefit our communities and our people.**My job is to represent everyone in the Greater Lehigh Valley — not a political party.**Over the past several months, I’ve heard from Democrats across our community who have told me they support the work I’m doing and want to see me continue serving our district. I’m grateful to every one of them.People like **former Democratic Alburtis Mayor Kathleen Palmer** have chosen to support our campaign. Her support is an example of what I believe this campaign is about: putting our community ahead of partisan politics and working together to get results.You don’t have to agree with me on every issue to believe that the Greater Lehigh Valley deserves a congressman who will listen, work with anyone, and put our community first.**Today, I’m proud to announce Democrats for Mackenzie.** This coalition brings together Democrats from across our community who support our campaign and believe in working together to deliver for the Greater Lehigh Valley.Whether you’re a Republican, Democrat, Independent, or someone who simply wants to see Washington work better, **there is a place for you on Team Mackenzie.****Let’s continue working together to Deliver for Our Community.**

Marquita is a mother, a community organizer, and a lifelong Memphian who has spent decades on the front lines fighting for the health, safety, and economic dignity of Tennessee families.
She isn't a career politician or a corporate lobbyist. She’s a grassroots force of nature.
She is running to represent all of us in Washington and replace Marsha Blackburn's rubber-stamp politics with real leadership.
[SPLIT A DONATION BETWEEN THE TNDP & MARQUITA BRADSHAW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139677856/648152986/-672779558?refcode=260921-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzRlMzZmNi0xYWI2LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JAqkcfvLZB8Pq2WEU_yLrNc4LmLQkv4lLiHZFwGfQv8=)

Marquita's platform is built on the real-world, kitchen-table issues that define our lives:
* **Environmental Justice & Safe Communities: **Growing up near a military defense depot in Memphis, Marquita saw firsthand how environmental neglect poisons our neighborhoods. In the Senate, she will fight tirelessly to protect our drinking water, hold corporate polluters accountable, and invest in sustainable, local jobs.
* **An Economy That Works for Working Families:** Marquita knows what it's like to stretch a dollar. She is fighting for real living wages, paid family leave, and strong labor rights so that Tennessee families can actually thrive, not just survive.
* **Strong Public Schools & Healthcare for All: **While Republicans funnel hundreds of millions of public tax dollars into private school vouchers and allow rural hospitals to close, Marquita is fighting to fully fund our public K-12 classrooms and expand healthcare access in every corner of our state.

Our opponent has spent years in Washington prioritizing corporate special interests, billionaire buddies, and extreme political stunts, consistently voting against Tennesseans’ best interests while working families pay the price.
To win a statewide fight, we must fund a massive, year-round grassroots ground game to talk to every single voter about the stakes in this election. That's why we’re asking you to stand with us today.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: [ICYMI] 1.2 million registered Texas voters have been placed on the voter suspense list.
body:
Greg Abbott is counting on Texas voters to sit this election out.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Recent news has created massive confusion across Texas because 1.2 million registered Texas voters have been placed on the voter “suspense” list.
When voters see headlines like this, many people assume that their registration has been cancelled or that they can no longer cast a ballot. This confusion is extremely dangerous, and it plays in Greg Abbott’s favor.
**I want to be clear about what this news means. Being on the voter suspense list does _not_ mean your voter registration has been purged. It simply means that local officials need an updated address before October 5th – the voter registration deadline here in Texas.**
Abbott and Republicans know that confusion can discourage people from the polls. And they do these deliberate tactics so that people are discouraged from showing up, because they know that the stakes of this race couldn’t be higher.
**And Abbott also knows that when Texans turn out, his time in office is up. That’s why we can’t allow a single eligible voter to be sidelined by confusion or bureaucratic red tape.**
Our campaign is organizing on the ground every single day between now and November to clear up the confusion, reach voters directly, and make sure our community is ready to make their voices heard at the ballot box.

Even as national Republicans outspent our grassroots campaign for U.S. Senate, polling still showed Roy with the slightest edge on his opponent, Michael Whatley. We told you they wouldn’t give up this battleground seat so easily though. We were right. That’s why President Trump came to NC last week to rally the base around his hand-picked candidate, why Vance doubled back today to repeat Trump’s unfounded lies and why their super PAC allies’ ad spend has eclipsed $100 million, and is still on the rise. With the GOP pulling out all the stops to crush us in these final 43 days of the cycle, a new poll has this race down to a virtual tie. If they wipe out our lead entirely, Democrats will have no shot at taking back the Senate. Republicans will hang on to control until at least 2029. Doris voted for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act to strengthen background checks for gun buyers under 21, provided funding for state crisis-intervention programs, addressed the “boyfriend loophole,” and backed the Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act to make it easier for victims of gun violence to pursue legal action against gun manufacturers and dealers. But she didn’t stop there. Doris secured billions in federal funding for flood-risk reduction and prevention for Sacramento, worked to expand access to mental health care and crisis services, and supported a more resilient electric grid and community preparedness for extreme weather and other disasters. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | ---|--- | | —Team Doris As a Member of Congress, Doris works to ensure that the voices of her district’s constituents are heard in Congress, and fights for the needs of the Sacramento region. **[Will you put $6 toward helping me meet my new neighbors? →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139678255/648175571/789508428?refcode=260921_RG_assignment-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTlmYThlZS0yMGI2LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kzd-DclUUosg7zCvfTzQmppeyBVFas6dlosr2GKhSgM=)**
I refuse to be the kind of congressman who only talks to the people who already agree with him. Every family in this district deserves to know who's fighting for them — and making that introduction takes resources we don't currently have.

That isn't my characterization of him. That's his voting record.** Tiffany and Trump's agenda means higher prices for Wisconsinites. It also means cuts to vital services and more challenges ahead. [**Before I go on, will you click here and donate to David's campaign and Battleground Wisconsin?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquchf2e3e-bIm5hAkq2zKIjvamPfag9y_bswSQjaYCFy9MjdWE1wV2uXo3NcOqsJcFtgsV_KgISdRGF7nV1t9x3jSQilVapE1rOhUuO6uIOMIyJSzCR3thUx0ruIlXqzoAxkpFIF4zOhplQzivIZawecq20uUzGY-wTlHmsQUFHGCj-eNyrL-X08pahlc_M6ZUWWiv2SIf7Wwwe1E_kBR5B8PradBhkQFqNmUdP6a3giGz-5_uwea0hU1Ti69-BK9Jn3y4dWK3_zp_uLbmLOX6QhHsVibqabKMTMxoiBuD2UgjHRntevREz6mbbEtlaf6OLFA_JsZpkDIfYvFyLNxseCrIt-8uUW4LifhJuzGf2GJrIoBf2xSWwiegDkflOg35uRkoSj4YVP905wvQ-6zFAAjb2RuUdwD2LVWUEr5c4SjwkM2CXSygoXfsrsSFVnz0/4u9/33kjmCuyQLCss92wgWZ2HQ/h1/h001.PezeGcUE4BPEsksDZXeODLUTlNuJQg3jWuDqXWnwMaQ) And he's got the money to talk over it. **At the end of July, he was sitting on close to $5 million, a good chunk of it from the Uihleins and Diane Hendricks.** Restoration PAC gets funding from the Uihlein family and has spent over $4 million on TV ads that target David Crowley. clean_body: At the end of July, Tom Tiffany was sitting on close to $5 million, a good chunk of it from the Uihleins and Diane Hendricks | | | | Derek, I'll give it to you straight. Tom Tiffany has voted with Donald Trump 100 percent of the time. That isn't my characterization of him. That's his voting record. Tiffany and Trump's agenda means higher prices for Wisconsinites. It also means cuts to vital services and more challenges ahead. And he's got the money to talk over it. At the end of July, he was sitting on close to $5 million, a good chunk of it from the Uihleins and Diane Hendricks. Restoration PAC gets funding from the Uihlein family and has spent over $4 million on TV ads that target David Crowley. Here's what eight years in this job taught me. Wisconsin doesn't decide anything by much. Our last three presidential races were all inside a single point. David won his own primary by about half a point. The latest Marquette poll shows a tie with his opponent. I've been there, Derek. Today I announced that our coalition of 12 attorneys general secured a unanimous settlement with Paramount Skydance Corporation, resolving our lawsuit challenging its proposed merger with Warner Bros. Discovery.** **_This lawsuit was a clear-cut antitrust case, and I’m proud to say we have achieved a strong outcome that will protect consumers, workers, and competition._** ** Here’s some of what was in the settlement: ** ** → A massive investment in film and television production right here in the U.S., to the tune of _at least_ **$1.5 billion** in additional domestic production over the next five years.** ** → A commitment to release at least 30 movies per year for two years, and 32 movies per year for the following three years. Each year, 20% of those movies must be blockbusters, and four of them must be independent films.** ** What’s more, Paramount _must_ honor previously established collective bargaining agreements AND must bargain in good faith with unions in years to come. ** ** They must establish a $25 million independent film fund that they contribute to annually to purchase indie films, and pay $9.5 million annually for workforce training and career development in film and TV production. ** ****And they must establish a news editorial independence board to support CBS News’ and CNN's continued editorial independence — protecting the integrity of these networks’ objective, fact-based reporting.**** ** The settlement also sets guardrails around negotiations with cable providers and theaters to help ensure consumer prices are fair, and it requires Paramount and Warner Bros. to continue negotiating their cable packages separately — preserving the competition they have today. ** ** The agreement includes provisions for potential future developments: if Congress passes a federal film tax credit, a full 20% of all film production must be done here in the U.S. for the first two years, and 30% for the next three — a major increase from the 5% Paramount currently does here. And if either California or New York passes an uncapped state film tax incentive, Paramount must increase domestic production so that at least _40%_ happens in the U.S. ** ** _And this is critical: every single word in this settlement is court-enforceable. Meaning that if Paramount ever fails to comply with these provisions or breaks its commitments, we can, and we will, take them to court._** ** Over the course of my office’s investigation and litigation in this case, I met directly with many of the workers who would be most impacted by a prospective merger. They were clear: their top concern was protecting their jobs — today, and for years to come. And the fact is, there is no Hollywood without the people hard at work, both on and off the screen, making the magic happen — the writers, actors, producers, lighting and sound engineers, editors, catering crews, set designers, and so many more. ** ** Growing up, my mom and dad were committed union members and labor organizers. I watched them fight for workers’ rights. I spent weeknights and weekends at protests, on picket lines, and in community meetings. That experience is what led me to this career in public service, standing up for working people — a responsibility I don’t take lightly. ** ** When companies break the law, rig markets, or exploit the public, we take them on. We have, we are, and we will continue to protect consumers, stand up for workers, defend your Constitutional rights and freedoms, and protect our democracy. We are all in — on _all_ of that. ** ****First and foremost, I am proud and honored to serve as**** _the people’s attorney_****. Your fights are my fights — and we’re not going anywhere.** ** ** Thanks for reading, and for being a part of this team. I couldn’t do any of this work without you.** ** The fight continues.** ** —Rob Rob BontaAttorney General of California

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Haaland took their money. Two days later she wanted a pause.
body:
Plus: Gas is up 52%, and no midterm year this century comes close | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/9wn16PWNjnj?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | Deb Haaland took $87,200 from the people behind the Project Jupiter data center, and two days after that story broke she called for a pause on new data centers. [A reporter asked her how voters are supposed to trust her](https://us.list-manage.com/17TLLD7JoL1?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) to regulate her own donors, and the two of us came away from her answer with very different grades.

Plus, gas is up 52% this year, the biggest jump in any midterm year this century, and Republicans are running out of time to do anything about it.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ZC732vKb33l?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🔥 **SHE TOOK THE DATA CENTER MONEY. NOW SHE WANTS TO REGULATE THEM.**
KOB asked her a direct question. She talked about how much elections cost now and what she'll do about Medicaid and SNAP, and she never came back to what she was asked.
Krysty coached big companies on this for years. Her rule is simple. Get your message out, then go back and answer the question. Haaland skipped the second half. Mark thought the answer was better than people will admit, and he knows he's going to hear about that. Fair warning, he's not reading those emails. 😉

💰 **$3.4 MILLION AGAINST $503,000**
Haaland raised $3.4 million this summer. Gregg Hull has about $503,000 left. If you've watched a football game lately, you already know where her money went.
Early voting opens October 6. The people in line that morning decided months ago. The voters who will settle this race are still deciding, and a poll should land in October that tells us whether the ads are working on them.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/16dv9DxyhA1?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🚨 **GAS IS UP 52%, AND THE GOP IS OUT OF TIME**
Harry Enten showed a chart this week. In a normal midterm year, gas goes up about 18%. This year it went up 52%.
We said a year ago this midterm was going to hurt. We were right, and we hate it. Mark thinks the House is gone. He sees two ways Republicans keep the Senate, and one of them runs through a Twitch streamer named Hasan Piker, who pulled up a poll on camera to back up his claim and the poll said the opposite.

🤖 **A CHATBOT NEARLY STARTED A FIGHT WITH CHINA**
CNN says an intelligence report written with AI claimed a Chinese ship was carrying nuclear weapons parts. Planes were in the air before anybody checked where the report came from. The whole thing was false.
Krysty connects it to the $40 million Anthropic has spent in Washington and the argument she and Mark had last week. Mark says he called it first. He did.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/IBSAZDWAQze?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | PLUS: Trump has a Greenland deal, the Babylon Bee is suing New Mexico over its AI satire law, an AI actress switched to Cantonese in the middle of a Piers Morgan interview, and Mark drove past a bull elk near Angel Fire with 35 cows and no sense of modesty.

| The MAGA Offers | Dear Reader,
On June 18th, an advancement to a potential Digital Dollar happened...
And most Americans didn’t even notice it.
Five federal agencies, including the Federal Reserve, proposed a rule that would tie your identity to _every_ digital dollar transaction you make.
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxYfNrZMABGO476HhEu3UjwzlIjR_La-7Q6ktts7LqHsxi56LyTa6vr2PGQNslPuMU52ZixL3uFTv8Zqz03wBCAh8jTaDLU7g90qbDqdWQ)
The Fed wants certain stablecoin (digital forms of a dollar) companies to start identifying users just like banks do.
And the scary thing is...
It’s being framed as a consumer protection measure.

It always is...isn’t it?
Like back in 1971, when the dollar was cut from gold.
Americans were told it was necessary and temporary...
**And yet, 50+ years later...your dollar has never been backed by gold again.**
Now, most people will completely ignore this ruling by The Federal Reserve...
And they’ll think:
“Whatever, it’s just another regulation.”
But this is EXACTLY why it matters.
Because although this may not be the Digital Dollar itself...
**It could certainly be an advancement to a Digital Dollar.**
One in which every digital dollar is tied to an identity...
And it’ll likely get more regulated through a series of ‘harmless’ rules just like this one.
That’s why I recorded this free presentation on our **[“Digital Dollar Immunity” System](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxYfNrZOqztJ_kKnq7y_wzXy-LaJ2Egmdvj9-MWa0BtRdNRueUrUb-mLe4PITucVgIXsBnyj6FUsjUHUpZ7fpMD3tCC5TiDCEEGV-nfGIQ)** \- allowing us to opt out of a digital dollar if it hits.

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16857?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.22_Haaland-New-America_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&t=4&akid=3175%2E259176%2EfCVm5R)

Peter, in case you missed it: **Donald Trump wants to change the name of New Mexico to New America.** [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16858?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.22_Haaland-New-America_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&t=5&akid=3175%2E259176%2EfCVm5R) Instead of focusing on the issues that matter to hardworking families, he’s pushing another distraction while families face higher costs and rising gas prices.

Here’s my message: New Mexico will always be New Mexico. If my Republican opponent wants to welcome Donald Trump’s reckless agenda into our state, then he can be the governor of New America. **Meanwhile, I’m fighting for New Mexicans and standing up for what makes New Mexico, New Mexico.** [**That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in and split a donation today between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help me win this November and make sure New Mexico always has a fighter in its corner?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11124?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.22_Haaland-New-America_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&amount=22&t=6&akid=3175%2E259176%2EfCVm5R) | [SPLIT $22 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11124?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.09.22_Haaland-New-America_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&amount=22&t=7&akid=3175%2E259176%2EfCVm5R)
---
Being New Mexican is something special.

Our roots run deep. They’re in the acequias, cornfields, lowriders, and chile harvests. In the food we cook and the traditions we pass down, and in the communities that have cared for one another for generations.

My roots here run 35 generations deep. I am the proud descendant of fierce Pueblo women, a grandfather who worked as a diesel mechanic and tended his cornfield, a grandmother who taught me to love New Mexican cooking, and parents who taught me the meaning of service and sacrifice.

These aren’t just my stories. **_They’re part of what makes New Mexico, New Mexico._**

* Polls keep showing this open Senate seat is a dead heat.
* We won our primary by a huge margin.
* We just earned a Toss-Up ranking from Cook Political Report.
* Nate Silver ranked our race as the closest Senate race in the nation.
* This is a once-in-a-generation election that will alter the balance of power in Washington.

It’s because his billionaire bosses are terrified that their grip over Iowa is slipping — and with it, their narrow Senate majority.
**But most of all, they’re terrified that a guy like me — a guy without family connections, from a working-class background, who’s fought and scraped for every ounce of success he’s had — could soon be rolling down the halls of power.**
Since Vance didn’t say this, I will: Iowans deserve so much better than a politician who gets filthy rich while they clip coupons.
One thing we know for sure: wherever Vance goes, MAGA money will follow. We’re already facing $55 million in dark money, and Elon Musk is increasingly targeting this race.

subject: SAVE COLLEGE SPORTS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ted Cruz for Senate
body:
Democrats Cory Booker and Chris Murphy, both from the far-left, are leading the charge against this bill. They were doing everything they can to defeat this bill.

| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Conservative,
---
There's something that can bring more Americans together than almost any other topic: the love of college sports. We might have some of the biggest rivals on Game Day. Longhorns vs. AggiesLSU vs. Ole Miss Alabama vs. GeorgiaArmy vs. Navy But the love of college sports is universal. **_It 's a uniquely American institute._** And what's what we must protect it... Today is a chance for us to stand up and fight for the half million college athletes who are competing right now because, if the Senate doesn't act, hundreds of thousands of those students will see their roster slots go away and their scholarships go away. But here's the good news: we have more than half of the Democratic caucus, even though multiple major left-leaning interest groups - _trial lawyers, AFL-CIO, and the NAACP_ \- are lobbying against it. The NFL, the NBA, Major League Baseball, National Hockey League are all supporting the bill. The NBA Players Association and the NFL Players Association are supporting this bill. The US Olympic and Paralympic Committee is enthusiastically supporting this bill. **But if nothing changes, it could mean major cuts to important programs outside of football.** American Olympians train at US colleges and universities, and one consequence of this spending spiral is that schools are spending more on football, so they're cutting everything else. That means they're slashing Olympic sports and women's sports, _and that is a terrible outcome._ Let's fight for the students to protect their rights and their future. Let's come together and demonstrate that the Senate - _Republicans and Democrats_ \- working together, can lead and protect an institution that is unique and valuable, that is college sports in America. **So what can you do?** **[Call your representatives and tell them to SAVE COLLEGE SPORTS](https://trk.email.tedcruz.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6MjE0NTQxMDEsImUiOiJtZy1lbmM6NWh6RDRoYmhSOTR0SVViRGFVQXlzUGowaHcxSkVGa0EiLCJyaSI6IjEzODc0OTA4NDUiLCJycSI6IjAyLWIyNjI2NS0xMDhjNDQ2NDU1N2I0MmNiYWFlN2I3YTM5OWI2MTg0NyIsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjAiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5jb25ncmVzcy5nb3YvbWVtYmVycy9maW5kLXlvdXItbWVtYmVyIn0/iiUydSt_Bk8msaU0nO-fCw).** Don't let Cory Booker, Chris Murphy, and far-Left special interests stop this important bill. Ted Cruz

subject: Take it from me, this is close
body:
Since Trump’s super PAC started buying ads in North Carolina, Roy’s lead has been cut in half.

Folks,

I first started working with Roy longer ago than I care to remember, so I’ve seen him run tough races, including in 2016 when he won by just 10,000 votes. But in all my years as Roy’s pollster, I’ve never seen him in a race like this.
**[_I spend all day looking at the numbers. That’s my job. So believe me when I tell you: This race is closer than you think it is. Roy needs your support, so if you’re able, please chip in a donation to him today._](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1420&amount=5&t=8&akid=3767%2E124072%2EXHRFky)**
If you’re still with me, let me tell you why.
**North Carolina is a notoriously hard and expensive state to campaign in.** It’s big, and its voters are spread out all over the state. That means that there’s no efficient way for the campaign to buy ads, which means that those ads get more and more expensive.
**Republicans have all the money in the world to make up the difference.** Between super PACs like Trump’s and the RNC’s $125 million war chest, the GOP has every dollar they need to take over the North Carolina airwaves and drown out Roy’s message. The campaign is fighting back, but it’s getting harder and harder.
**This race is already tightening.** Since Trump’s super PAC started buying ads in North Carolina, Roy’s lead has been cut in half. We’ve always known this could happen – but with less than two months until Election Day, it’s more important than ever that we fight back and win this race.
But beating this GOP super PAC money is going to take all of us, so Roy needs your support TODAY. **[_Please, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help me fight back and protect voting across North Carolina?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1420&amount=5&t=9&akid=3767%2E124072%2EXHRFky)**

name: Vera Smith
subject: National forests are in danger – take action today!
body:
Speak up to keep forests protected by the Roadless Rule!

Speak up to keep forests protected by the Roadless Rule!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6043210/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6043211/38SyG9Xl)

Speak up to defend our national forest lands! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6043212/38SyG9Xl)

Defender,

The Trump administration’s plan to eliminate the Roadless Rule could reshape America’s wilds as we know them. It’s vital that we speak up right away!

Keep our roadless forests protected: Send your comment today! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6043213/38SyG9Xl)

Here’s what’s at stake – the Forest Service’s own environmental analysis confirms the damage this rollback would cause:

327 threatened and endangered species and 71 designated critical habitats would likely be negatively impacted.

3,490 sensitive species would face increased threats – 97% of all sensitive species that live in our national forests.

24 million people who rely on drinking water that originates in roadless forests may see worsened water quality.

More human-caused wildfires.

More of our national forests invaded by non-native species that degrade wildlife habitat.

This is a reckless proposal with a host of hazards and no benefits — and the Forest Service's own analysis proves it.

We still have time to stop it. The updated comment deadline is October 6. Don’t wait to make your voice heard!

Our national forests are in danger. Take action with Defenders today to keep our National Forest roadless lands protected for future generations! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6043214/38SyG9Xl)

Sincerely,

Vera Smith

Director National Forests & Public Lands

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

| [ ](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001n__64HZsyQq9ymxh7EkBV56zp_qVwfqPWmGJWda6zRMkQ_wsvkuIjbw57kb1mn5YR04iqYc7VEReUeAjYJG3AB1d9wiZSy9ym_Pxmpkl54poyWCpJpfz8tMsnlyHFXhDynZaBV-EqwJAVPsXDlM0lwLDOAF2tPmbSwoD6KjHjIKAECGf2tkwxeh2hcJkUG-A5dylyMhNwkQzBQjpKYqOnPkidklSJW17rizp0H5M6rY=&c=u6y3yH9yFbCeS2RulhvPq-7KQQsXIOTFBsK7Q8sKWgnIbncSvsUbjg==&ch=sXW-hfTn95E-LmVxBXuxM9DwPQFVtPQQX4PqrrPNLOP11MYkz4BnNQ==)
---
[](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001n__64HZsyQq9ymxh7EkBV56zp_qVwfqPWmGJWda6zRMkQ_wsvkuIjbw57kb1mn5YR04iqYc7VEReUeAjYJG3AB1d9wiZSy9ym_Pxmpkl54poyWCpJpfz8tMsnlyHFXhDynZaBV-EqwJAVPsXDlM0lwLDOAF2tPmbSwoD6KjHjIKAECGf2tkwxeh2hcJkUG-A5dylyMhNwkQzBQjpKYqOnJUwsAD2tJsN8WhZwTISwHE=&c=u6y3yH9yFbCeS2RulhvPq-7KQQsXIOTFBsK7Q8sKWgnIbncSvsUbjg==&ch=sXW-hfTn95E-LmVxBXuxM9DwPQFVtPQQX4PqrrPNLOP11MYkz4BnNQ==) Friend, I was 29 years old when Susan Collins first became my senator.

That’s me in the middle of that photo, when my fellow loggers and I were up at the border fighting for fair wages.

Now I’m 58 years old, _and Susan is still my senator. _

After 30 years in Washington, she’s become a corporate puppet who does the bidding of her billionaire donors and Donald Trump – she’s voted with him 96% of the time.

Mainers are sick and tired of her broken promises and her fake concern. But being in the Senate for half of my entire life means every single voter is gonna know who she is when they see her name on the ballot this November.

On the other hand, I’m a logger from Allagash who started this campaign just a couple of weeks ago.

Mainers already know they don’t like Susan Collins, but they also need to know that they can get the government they deserve by voting for our campaign.

My team and I are criss-crossing this state to talk to as many folks as we can, but the fastest way to reach every Mainer between now and November is our ads.

body:
This election season, challenge yourself to take your biggest swing.
#
Hi there,
Today marks 6 weeks until Election Day—the last day of voting in the midterm elections, which will have resounding consequences for 2028, 2030, and beyond.
Defeating MAGA at the ballot box this year is doable, but the final outcome will be up to us. If we win, and how big, will depend on each of us doing our part, including folks who have never canvassed or phone banked before—**which is why today, we’re announcing The Big Swing Challenge!**
**The Big Swing Challenge invites everyone to commit to taking action, set a personal goal, and then take your biggest swing by stepping out of your comfort zone and talking with as many voters as possible.**
[](http://act.swingleft.org/go/2385?utm_source=em20260922-2858&t=1&akid=2858%2E1562180%2E4qG5E5)
In this year’s midterm elections, we have a unique chance to shift the balance of power now AND for years to come. Our goal isn’t just to eke out a slim House majority; it’s to win the midterms decisively in the House, the Senate, and in key state races, by margins too large to contest, with majorities too strong to fracture and powerful enough for Democrats to actually govern.
**This is our chance to steer the direction of the county not just for the next two years, but for more than a decade to come.**
To make it happen, we need to persuade more people to vote for Democrats over Republicans, including people who’ve swung away from Dems in the past or are considering doing so now. That requires having more substantive conversations with voters and non-voters across the political spectrum—including Democrats, Republicans, and Independents—than ever before. And we’re going to get it done with Ground Truth.
Ground Truth is Swing Left’s innovative people-powered canvassing program where we focus on listening first. But these conversations and these big wins can only happen if you are on our team!
Chances are you live in or near one of our target swing districts or states. To take your big swing, you can join a canvass led by another volunteer, sign up to host your own, or, with the training we’ll give you, go canvass in your nearest swing district whenever works best for you.
Millions of voters in swing districts and states across the country have never had a Democratic campaign knock on their door because of limited resources and too-narrow targeting. If we each call, knock on doors, or talk to a few voters (or a lot!), we can collectively drive wins in close races and make sustained political change possible.
The Big Swing Challenge is an opportunity for all of us to take action and see what we can accomplish when thousands of people across the country take their biggest swing together.
[**If you’re ready to take part, click here to commit to the challenge today. We’ll share weekly updates on what you and other Big Swing Challenge takers are accomplishing, volunteer leaderboards, tips on talking with voters, and opportunities to volunteer in a swing district or state near you!**](http://act.swingleft.org/go/2385?utm_source=em20260922-2858&t=2&akid=2858%2E1562180%2E4qG5E5)
**[Commit To The Big Swing Challenge](http://act.swingleft.org/go/2385?utm_source=em20260922-2858&t=3&akid=2858%2E1562180%2E4qG5E5)**
The Swing Left community comprises thousands of committed volunteers and grassroots donors nationwide. There’s power in our numbers. Six weeks from now, we’ll know what we accomplished together. So let’s show up, talk with as many voters as possible by phone, door-to-door, and online, and turn out voters in swing districts across the country.
We have the power to organize, persuade, and shape the balance of power for years to come.
Thank you for taking the challenge with us—let’s get out there and win back the House, the Senate, and key state races this year to restore the national balance of power!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260922-1&t=4&refcode2=2858_1562180_4qG5E5&akid=2858%2E1562180%2E4qG5E5)

# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1966%2E1086043%2E_0lGA_)
Peter, it's Wes.
You may know I’m a veteran, father, and Maryland’s first Black governor. If there’s one thing I’ve learned from my time serving the people of Maryland, it’s this:
**You can't govern by throwing temper tantrums when you don’t get your way.**
That’s all I’ve seen come out of Trump’s Washington -- policies based on fear and chaos, not love and compassion.
**That’s not how we do things in Maryland.**
I’m proud to be a Governor who’s fighting to keep families fed, workers protected, and our schools fully funded -- even when Washington tries to pull the rug out from under us.
But this isn’t a fight I can keep up alone, Peter. Our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline hits September 30, in just over a week, and I need this team behind me to keep proving Maryland does things differently.

clean_body: Peter, it's Wes. You may know I’m a veteran, father, and Maryland’s first Black governor. If there’s one thing I’ve learned from my time serving the people of Maryland, it’s this: You can't govern by throwing temper tantrums when you don’t get your way. That’s all I’ve seen come out of Trump’s Washington -- policies based on fear and chaos, not love and compassion. That’s not how we do things in Maryland. I’m proud to be a Governor who’s fighting to keep families fed, workers protected, and our schools fully funded -- even when Washington tries to pull the rug out from under us. But this isn’t a fight I can keep up alone, Peter. Our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline hits September 30, in just over a week, and I need this team behind me to keep proving Maryland does things differently. Elevate, Wes

_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| John Fetterman lies, half-truths, innuendos, and smears... | | | | | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeLBqhkSJKofPF6CH_1nh2LvLLePMbhEnqktq1YEx-CD2gwXYQ8qkKuM6SrUsh08GuHAs5b1dEWmyceEhPe5dhuw0b7FTmmH8e3RxMmDw)
---
| | Dear Friend who has common sense, I'm always going to stand with America. I'm always going to reject the extremes. I'm always going to reject Socialism. I'm always going to fight against the anti-American way of life. And this has enraged a lot of people in the media, in my party, and even former staffers --- disgruntled leakers who are viciously and anonymously attacking me. This is what happens when you put common sense and the wellbeing of the people you are supposed to represent ahead of party loyalty. But most of all, I think this is what happens when you clash with the Socialist movement "DSA!" that is hijacking the Democratic party. They want to... Abolish our borders Abolish the electoral college Abolish Israel Abolish the Senate and the Supreme Court (no, seriously, this is in the "DSA!" platform) That bad news is the "DSA!" crazies have gone from the political fringe to controlling one of America's major political parties—and onto ballots across the country. The good news is the hardworking, common-sense Americans I talk to every day still aren't buying it. I mean, a recent Rasmussen poll kind of proves it: 71% of Americans reject socialism 67% of Democrat voters reject socialism While 82% of Republican voters reject socialism But here's the thing. The loudest voice in the room is often the one that looks the most powerful. And I've got to say, the "DSA!" voices in Washington are loud and getting louder. The media is their megaphone. Which is why you may be under the false impression that people really do want the "DSA!" and their extreme policies Nothing could be further from the truth. **[I'm standing up to them.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeLBqhl8oq1JCdfdP7La2qOeen10-TCBBmX2izO9kHujJ0hiJPCpewpiwsgx-dqtBKmo4AfcT-aOFaLfQ29heYaIDWcrcc5HHV0yefCpw)** But sadly I'm pretty much alone on this side of the aisle. So, can I ask you a favor? Whatever your party affiliation is, can I ask you to stand with me against the daily barrage of hit-pieces **[If you can donate just $25 it would be a big help to me.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeLBqhmkXbG7YKvwzDYLm32KtabAv0RPl9uO8kbAhFuSQJdpw2p19IGvNKICvIPRGQIkHk-iyKnHCgfEhDP3qzLqUXzmN1GYiN52LKt_Q)** But it will also send a message. It will show the truth that the "real numbers" are on our side here in Pennsylvania, as well as around the rest of America. You know, I recently stood in front of the iconic U.S. Steel Mill and recorded a video talking about how my friend Dave McCormick and I banded together with President Trump to save this facility and the larger steel industry. But I'm not backing down. Even though I know the media... the "DSA!"... and the party bosses... are going to try even harder to defeat me:
---
**"Fetterman Draws Shadow Primary From Democrats Eager to Replace Him: The Pennsylvania senator has long irked members of his own party" ~ Bloomberg**
---
If you'll stand with me today, I know we can show them that we're not backing down and that the real numbers are on the side of common sense and putting our country first. Thank you! John Fetterman P.S. - I'll bet you're more than a little surprised to get this email from me. So, I want to say thanks for setting aside party affiliation for a second and hearing me out. You see, I'm not a progressive. And I'm definitely not a Democratic Socialist. I'm just a senator with a big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). If you see eye-to-eye with me, then I could sure use your help. The "DSA!" vision for Pennsylvania and for America is not a healthy one. It is a dangerous one.Common-sense people need to join together now to reject this vision before it's too late. **[Can I count on you to stand with me today?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeLBqhnYaClGgBcRp6TbvjM5zSTuv9QPi_K6BujRS8zOipDR6hlYya7yDxVaTj1Jnlph_hUW77RDPK20usnOq8Ml6axsAeNWJyeTcgksg)**

name: Team AOC
subject: Alexandria is mobilizing resources to win the midterms and take back the majority so we can make progress on issues like Medicare for All, universal childcare, a living wage, and so much more.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
There are elections throughout New York, up and down the ballot, that will decide whether Democrats take back the House and elect leaders who will fight for working people throughout our state.
That’s why last week Alexandria decided to direct $300,000 from her campaign to the New York State coordinated campaign.
**The funds have been earmarked for voter organizing efforts with half going to Spanish-language outreach.** This campaign is all about investing in community organizing and building coalitions in communities that are too often overlooked or taken for granted because how we win matters.
Alexandria didn't make this decision lightly. Grassroots supporters like you have given us every dollar our campaign has and we value the trust you’ve placed with this campaign. Here are some of the things supporters have shared with us:
> _“I trust AOC to fight hard for good policy and I like that the fundraising feels honest, direct, non-alarmist or gimmicky.”_
> _“I want to make sure her voice is heard and she is able to continue to support like-minded candidates across the country.”_
> _“My solution was to give as much money as I could to AOC and let her decide if she didn’t absolutely need it, she could funnel it to someone who needs it more.”_
**Alexandria is mobilizing resources to win the midterms and take back the majority so we can make progress on issues like Medicare for All, universal childcare, a living wage, and so much more.**
Alexandria will be heading to Buffalo, Syracuse, and Ithaca in the coming days to build coalitions that will elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will fight alongside her for the better future we all deserve.
And New York is just the start. Our goal is to travel to more places before Election Day to support candidates such as Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Angie Nixon in Florida to deliver a majority in the House and the Senate in November.
Organizing to win across the country takes serious financial resources. [Will you chip in $5 today to help Alexandria keep hitting the road and putting resources where they're needed most?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260922.dp8Cg_&refcode=em20260922-12330-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12330%2E2526796%2E2MZsCU)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260922.dp8Cg_&refcode=em20260922-12330-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=12330%2E2526796%2E2MZsCU)**
Whether you can chip in today or not, thank you so much for being here.
—Team AOC

# Tuesday, September 22, 2026

Something is happening in global finance that most Americans have never been told about. [It's called de-dollarization](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM1OhDAURp-m7IZcbks7XXRhnOBqXOgkLklpLzPV8pNSIL69wfgG7k_O9-V8XNurDTGM91c7kMn91I60L5FyptTakOZoR1ruaVpHT362yQ7TOrYIKE-gT4itdTls1ApbeNMTIfGCTKU0gKqEVsXDKA2dVRI5cO_0ufPO9Q4QlJBeU2eLYA4faMQKQNSyrMRZ1Eo44WVfaVEzAeRDnlL5OYUxP6iP39NGqXTTUETzyHleGH9i2DBs9n0vLQ5uO-f0dRAMG9Q3-SYZNi-392d-cLxZg2f8woGhXNauZvyS7PYnPr6gLJLx8x5iDItUTMB9sCH-buZ_ptoM_gQAAP__trt6oQ). According to the World Gold Council, central banks bought more gold in 2022, 2023, and 2024 than in any three-year period in over half a century. China, India, Russia, Turkey, and Poland are leading the pace.

All while:
• The BRICS bloc has expanded and is developing alternatives to dollar-based trade
• Russia and China are settling bilateral trade in their own currencies, not dollars
• Major emerging economies are reducing their U.S. Treasury holdings

The dollar's strength has long been supported by global demand. If that demand softens, [every dollar-denominated asset in your retirement account could feel the effect](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM1OhDAURp-m7IZcbks7XXRhnOBqXOgkLklpLzPV8pNSIL69wfgG7k_O9-V8XNurDTGM91c7kMn91I60L5FyptTakOZoR1ruaVpHT362yQ7TOrYIKE-gT4itdTls1ApbeNMTIfGCTKU0gKqEVsXDKA2dVRI5cO_0ufPO9Q4QlJBeU2eLYA4faMQKQNSyrMRZ1Eo44WVfaVEzAeRDnlL5OYUxP6iP39NGqXTTUETzyHleGH9i2DBs9n0vLQ5uO-f0dRAMG9Q3-SYZNi-392d-cLxZg2f8woGhXNauZvyS7PYnPr6gLJLx8x5iDItUTMB9sCH-buZ_ptoM_gQAAP__trt6oQ). # Reports from the Campaign Trail
---
| This week I got to spend time with Michigan voters in:

* Owosso where I met with local business owners, hearing their concerns about the issues they have and how the Secretary of State could do better by them
* Mt. Pleasant Michigan as the Keynote speaker for the Michigan Manufactured Housing Association annual meeting
* The Serbian Festival in Warren
* The Ganesh Chaturthi event in Rochester Hills
* The Romanian Food Festival in Warren
* The Macomb County Clerk's Association Luncheon in Sterling Heights
* A zoom meeting with the Michigan Auto Dealers Association and the Detroit Auto Dealers Association

---
We still have a long road to go for the next 42 days but here is something that is becoming very clear: people want authentic leaders who will value their questions, hear their concerns, and take time to trouble shoot on reaching a solution.
It is a privilege and an honor to be invited into different industries and houses of worship in my effort to get to know the people that call Michigan home.
Everywhere I turn I realize our state has so much potential if we will just bring common sense solutions back to the table.
42 DAYS TO GO, MICHIGAN! Please continue to spread the word!

Friend,

Parents send their kids to school to learn reading, writing, and math... not to receive anatomically explicit toys with removable body parts from school staff.

But that’s exactly what might be coming to Minnesota schools soon.

**Fox News reported that “MyGender Dolls” will be available to school counselors, educators, and clinicians this school year.**

These “trans” dolls were developed through the University of Minnesota’s Early Innovation Fund, under a program Gov. Tim Walz has championed and been personally honored for. _They ship with removable, swappable genitalia and are built for children**ages 4-10**_.

And it gets worse...

Not a single Minnesota parent that Defending Education spoke with had received any notification about the dolls. **_There is no confirmed way to opt out_**.

That’s why Defending Education filed a federal privacy complaint – citing violations of the Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment, and the First and Fourteenth Amendments.

I’m Nicole Neily, President of **Defending Education** – a national grassroots organization fighting to restore academic excellence and parental rights in America’s schools.

We believe four-year-olds have no business handling anatomically explicit material from any adult, in any building, for any reason. **We believe parents – not a governor, not a university lab – decide what’s appropriate for their child.**

And we believe it’s time to ask Americans plainly where they stand.

Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law actually does. Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Friend: it makes it harder for anyone -- me included -- to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent. I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; this is just the beginning. Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General -- the one person in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Friend. That's the system protecting itself. I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't -- daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. They're right -- and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. Here's something most people don't see, Friend: doing this work independently means there's no network paying for the flight to Sacramento, no legal department covering me if a state files a complaint over a story, no corporate budget for the cameras and editors it takes to get this footage in front of you. When I showed up at that rally, Lincoln Media Foundation was on site with their own journalists to cover it, because they understood what was actually at stake before most of the country did. That 's why I'm partnering with Lincoln Media Foundation. They understand how important it is to support independent journalists and help us keep doing the work without compromising what makes it independent in the first place. I'm grateful for their partnership and commitment, and - helping cover travel, equipment, and the costs that come with confronting people on camera instead of reading a press release about them. ## Man Shot by ICE Remains Detained
A 28-year-old DoorDash driver [shot by an ICE officer](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdD7ZCwZcuEhD96dNifbwclgx9i97gePto0seIdUUI43m-359zV8YYkivn7iT4_ea50RXjcRMZd6P-rviUTmkigkT5xQyHynNoKCXykqAGRcOJ80dNt49lbe6IacHq9TQWTM2m8P-qbqerFfQkTdmtXrx6A0MrbLQj01wnzllAbRW0JrHMPQjeLOSAo2eOtEp8oFzefBGTG-sa7zzSeWx5L2JbmP-rqL9IWASMOFz0e2nETBVzuUWMK24h3hLTzGcVG7pyydl3TLLf4AyLCQpLflITEV62jH5kF4SU72oVBnxuqkImLQdjQEYBExNcf77CjGG2g-iU68dQ_x7iv9X5ungTwAAAP__fh6LzA) in North Austin on Sunday is being held at a detention center in Pearsall, southwest of San Antonio, with the bullet still lodged in his back, his attorney said. Wilber Rafael Garces Perez was delivering for DoorDash when an unmarked car sideswiped him twice, and officers shot him in the back, [attorney Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1ygzAQhU8DnRixCGQKFWnonDYls0aL2YmQPGgB5_YZx0dI--bN-_m-ruMVOXC8f-JKTp5zGiOdOZAIbeO65--MexaOGSNGSZGT7DGOoKFTulcAI07CB40GS-9u2vd1Sa62vdbW9O2lXJztkNDO2uimN92MGoDam60n2yE0dCnZveJ0D1DXGpq2sra7gG9n0lCjJ1MYTZ4lbZUsJPTEPIefdNBWTWktg1tEHrloPgoYChjO86zm9LTv4S9LAcPrVQHDW1M8kcpLSsLxrgIKZVGeBDlkhbe0izp4El7LzfnHySFw7mxh9H1FDn-l8l9Yh4PfAAAA__9wQII-) said. Garces Perez was apparently treated at a hospital and then released into ICE custody. His lawyer reported that he had received no pain medication while being detained and slept on the floor. The Department of Homeland Security said Garces Perez is a Venezuelan who [entered the country illegally](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1y3DAMhU9DddwhsfpZFirSqHPalBpEBFcYU6BHhFb27TNyjuAKKDB43_v-vM1vyJnl-Rs3GvUzlVnorJlUaZ-3o75XPKqyVBQULcJFD5EZHPTWBQsw46L8ornFJo5_XQy-odEPwbmhDd2jWcfge4I4pBb8vXOYgEIXfXoMwbdd6JeGx-udCwDeO7h3t2HoHxC7RA48RmpN6yiylv2mKyl9Yk35q7xovy1la_K4qn5Uc_9lYDIwned5WzIv77CWo2qR68rAdBW7BioXwWxgumINTC5cuzcw8UIWnyRq61qKVosS7VkOidVuKJbF_tdhvylsSYkXxlxtxS-75CJkYGr2MX6cnDPXfjCte27I-RtVf6r4NcK_AAAA__9gW5JE) and had a final order of removal, adding that he was attempting to flee when he was shot. Lincoln-Goldfinch says Garces Perez entered legally seeking asylum and holds a valid work permit. U.S. Rep. Greg Casar and the civil rights group LULAC called on ICE to release him. Three Drown in Houston County Lake Three men drowned after their Sunday evening on a private lake near Grapeland in Houston County, and the search for the third man stretched into Monday afternoon. Four men were fishing when the boat flipped over at , Houston County Chief Deputy Ryan Martin said. One man swam to shore and made it out safely. The other three never resurfaced. The call came in at 8:06 p.m., and deputies searched into the early hours. The sheriff's office called in divers from , with several other agencies assisting. The bodies of two of the men were found in the lake on Monday morning, and the third was recovered later in the day. Their names haven't been released. The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department is investigating. The woman said "no, thank you." Grace said have a good day and turned to leave.

**That 's when someone screamed from inside the house. A second woman ran out the door - she chased Grace down the driveway, shoved her, and hit her in the head with both fists.**

As Grace tried to run away and reached the end of the driveway, the woman threw a dinner roll that hit her in the face - **and kept following her down the street, screaming that she hoped Grace would be run over by a car.**

Grace filed a police report. The woman was arrested and charged.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Peter, this is just one story from one of Students for Life Action's door-to-door canvassers during the last midterm election.

I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead.

But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad, mailer, or text ever could - and the effect doesn't disappear after one election.

**Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote pro-life again in the _next_ election cycle, too.**

_And, it only costs us about $3 for every door we knock._

Not only that, but we'll be deploying teams of pro-life activists to blanket church parking lots with flyers exposing the records of pro-abortion politicians in key districts every Sunday in September and October.

This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter.

Last cycle, this approach worked.

***** In Oklahoma,** our student canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion senators who killed our Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking Bill - and voters threw them out.

***** In South Carolina,** we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who protected the _Life at Conception Act 's_ enemies - and they lost too.

***** In North Carolina,** 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries outright.

| The MAGA Offers | Dear Reader,
On June 18th, an advancement to a potential Digital Dollar happened...
And most Americans didn’t even notice it.
Five federal agencies, including the Federal Reserve, proposed a rule that would tie your identity to _every_ digital dollar transaction you make.
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeeuPINDzy4_jDzYZUHmpUQho_8WE9LnaOUUvR_AVJ7R_FI4GckX6VSiB3GSnVR1ILeHGJH2cONE--65DNTCqZBiZ0juO_JC3wToHZbUw)
The Fed wants certain stablecoin (digital forms of a dollar) companies to start identifying users just like banks do.
And the scary thing is...
It’s being framed as a consumer protection measure.
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeeuPIO_7VDmdAmWIrHDd6IEZIRs5qGqWnw-L6OL4nE7yoZHNzBBRFFQ6PLnbObNkl0Yh6Ofi_XdtWz6jx7UJ2sdgFcVVCThD9YKeSpuQ)
It always is...isn’t it?
Like back in 1971, when the dollar was cut from gold.
Americans were told it was necessary and temporary...
**And yet, 50+ years later...your dollar has never been backed by gold again.**
Now, most people will completely ignore this ruling by The Federal Reserve...
And they’ll think:
“Whatever, it’s just another regulation.”
But this is EXACTLY why it matters.
Because although this may not be the Digital Dollar itself...
**It could certainly be an advancement to a Digital Dollar.**
One in which every digital dollar is tied to an identity...
And it’ll likely get more regulated through a series of ‘harmless’ rules just like this one.
That’s why I recorded this free presentation on our **[“Digital Dollar Immunity” System](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxeeuPIPxrjrf18jzjmS4DB8VuDh4wVF9cRpcho8NAtTUaSCKW0Zpt254xnkr-70wjyqPW2XTQv1J-sWZT_Ag7MJMdqwLgNspSrH7kCCgQ)** \- allowing us to opt out of a digital dollar if it hits.

our most historic election cycle to date. We’ve secured ten primary
victories, and at least seven new Justice Democrats will be sworn in come
January.

But the fight isn’t over — not when we have three more pivotal general
election battles ahead. In 42 days, we can elect:

* Mai Vang (CA-07): A Sacramento City Councilmember and community
organizer taking on Rep. Doris Matsui, a 20-year entrenched incumbent
who answers to corporate donors rather than working families. Her
corporate allies just went on the air with attacks against Mai.

justice challenging Rep. Jimmy Gomez — an incumbent beholden to AI,
AIPAC, and Crypto lobbyists who is currently under a House ethics

fighter against billionaires like Elon Musk and the far right, taking

through a racist gerrymandering scheme.

confronting the corporate-backed political establishment and advancing a

slashing everyday costs, and putting an end to taxpayer-funded war and

clean_body: Friend, My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona. That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. Every $50 you give sponsors a ballot chaser like me for one full day. That's about 75 doors and 25 real conversations with voters who haven't made up their minds yet, and who deserve to hear from us before it's too late. # Dr. Bob Sears:
The Man, the Myth, the Legend
| |
---
|
---
If you look up the **Wikipedia entry for Dr. Sears** , you’ll read from mainstream media sources that he is noted for his “unorthodox” and “dangerous” views on childhood vaccination. If you ask any crunchy mama under 50 about his work, you’ll hear him described with words like **hero, champion, and pioneer**. With the 2007 publication of his controversial book, _The Vaccine Book_ , Dr. Sears skyrocketed in notoriety from neighborhood pediatrician to a **nationally known figure** as expectant parents turned to his book for advice on alternative and selective vaccine schedules. After years of witnessing, firsthand, the difference in **the overall wellness between his unvaccinated and vaccinated patients** , he updated his wildly popular book in 2019 with even fewer vaccine recommendations than before. Next week, you can meet this modern-day medical freedom advocate at an exclusive screening of the documentary _An Inconvenient Study_ , which explores vaccinated-versus-unvaccinated health outcomes. The movie will be followed by a** _live discussion and audience Q &A with Dr. Bob and the film’s producer, Del Bigtree of The HighWire_**. Optional VIP tickets include an exclusive after-party dinner with the speakers. **We hope you can join us in San Antonio this coming Monday, September 28, for this rare opportunity.**

name: Ken Burns
subject: Heartfelt request...
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
Eugene Vindman deserves your support.

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260922-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1131_3892029_eWmCIf&akid=1131%2E3892029%2EeWmCIf)
---
Hi, it’s Ken Burns. I am coming to you with a heartfelt request:
[**If you, like me, are deeply concerned about the future of our democracy and the rising tide of extremism, I urge you to join me in supporting Eugene Vindman’s reelection campaign for Congress today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260922-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1131_3892029_eWmCIf&akid=1131%2E3892029%2EeWmCIf)
As a filmmaker, my life’s work has been dedicated to capturing pivotal moments in American history — moments that have shaped our nation’s identity and spirit. I’ve documented our country navigating through its darkest hours and emerging stronger and understanding the profound consequences of these moments.
Throughout my career, I’ve seen our nation evolve in countless ways, but one constant remains: our democracy, the cornerstone of our republic, and the essence of what it means to be American.
Yet, at this very moment, our democracy faces an unprecedented challenge — a critical inflection point. We are at a juncture where our very rights and freedoms are threatened.
The stakes have never been higher. Our democracy stands at a crossroads — and this moment requires leaders who will unify our country in defense of the very fabric of our nation — no matter political party or affiliation. Eugene Vindman is one of those leaders.
I first met Eugene and Alex nearly 40 years ago, when I interviewed the Vindman twins and their grandmother for a documentary about the meaning of the Statue of Liberty. It was shortly after they fled Soviet Ukraine and sought refuge in the United States as children.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260922-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1131_3892029_eWmCIf&akid=1131%2E3892029%2EeWmCIf)
Their father came to the U.S. with $759 in his pocket, three children, and a dream of giving them a better life. And through hard work and perseverance, they achieved just that.
Eugene’s story is the embodiment of the American dream. He is a Ukrainian immigrant, an Army Veteran, and a lifelong defender of our democracy. He’s a good man — one who has devoted himself to defending our country with courage, selflessness, and resilience, even at his own expense.
Eugene has never failed to hold our leaders accountable — no matter their party. But right now, not only is our government baselessly retaliating against him through an investigation aimed at removing him from Congress, but he is being attacked relentlessly by the far right, all because he has never failed to hold our leaders accountable.
We need to keep people like Eugene in Congress — leaders who continue to stand up for our democracy and represent the true spirit of America.
So it would mean a lot to me if you could support his reelection campaign today to help keep him fighting for us in the People’s House.
[**Can you please contribute $25 or whatever you can afford to Eugene Vindman’s campaign for Congress today? I am asking because it is critical.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260922-av-ken-burns&refcode2=1131_3892029_eWmCIf&akid=1131%2E3892029%2EeWmCIf)

---
| | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

It is important to remember: AI is the nuclear arms race of the 21st Century. Nuclear superiority made conventional warfare largely obsolete, giving the United States the ability to dictate international policy after World War II. This golden age, the so-called _[Pax Americana](https://substack.com/redirect/4c54f73f-0809-46d4-ae15-daf02d2cfa1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ,_ created the most prosperous, safe period of time ever known in human history.
However, many of those who have benefited from America's generosity seek to undermine us - and AI could be the way they do that. Super-intelligent cyberattacks could leave us defenseless, allowing our enemies to run roughshod over us. That's why the President is pushing so hard for American AI:
[| | | | | Laura Loomer
---
@LauraLoomer

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f699de7-21a9-40cd-b176-576f66ccd9d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Of course, public enemy No. 1 here is China. China has rejected calls to slow down AI development. No surprise there. China wants AI [dominance](https://substack.com/redirect/051c9102-b7b3-46cc-a1c8-f53b99cca7af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because it will finally give them superiority over the US. China has spent the last 30 years lying, cheating, and stealing to get our technology, but they have never been able to catch up. AI could finally let them do so.
And what's particularly concerning is how many AI CEOs are willing to cozy up to the Chinese Communist Party. It seems like all of them are on board with selling out, as [we have discussed here before](https://substack.com/redirect/c1debd9e-8996-47d7-84cd-1a69cd918131?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/834f381a-334f-42ce-8fa5-f0cb385daa26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For years, Washington has worked to choke off China's access to [advanced AI chips](https://substack.com/redirect/f545113d-98c4-4bb9-b8d3-b5ded4f33dd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But chips are only one piece of the puzzle. Building cutting-edge AI systems depends on three core elements: compute (chips and data centers), algorithms (the models developed by companies like OpenAI and Anthropic), and data, the specialized training information that teaches AI systems how to perform complex tasks. A growing body of reporting focuses on that third element.

But American [companies are happy to supply](https://substack.com/redirect/013bce46-788e-42b0-8f96-4a924d7e4ad0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this to Chinese customers! I miss when Corporate America at least remembered the America part.
Anthropic has done nothing to keep its large-language model Claude out of the hands of the Iranian regime, even when they use it to attack our Navy. As the Navy Times [recently reported](https://substack.com/redirect/167f4d7b-471d-423b-8521-0a6cc2279397?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> _[Iran] used the AI software to collect information that included a list of U.S. service members it had sourced from public military photographs, ship and aircraft transponders -- which broadcast a specific code that identifies them -- commercial satellite-imagery query scripts that help locate exact geographic visuals, and a breakdown of public websites that track U.S. Navy movements._
_The Iranian threat also used Claude to learn more about weaknesses in U.S. Navy shipboard systems that could be exploited._
Back in World War II we said, "Loose lips sink ships." Apparently, that doesn't apply to AI! This report came after an Anthropic researcher named Jacob Coxon resigned recently, issuing a scathing X [post](https://substack.com/redirect/88a0c121-06cc-4e1e-afa3-e278501bb1e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the recklessness of Anthropic and OpenAI:
> _" I resigned from Anthropic today. I spent the last three years doing pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic. Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives. More thoughts below."_
[| | | | | Jacob Coxon

Although a Muslim country itself, the UAE puts Western countries to shame with its willingness to label the Muslim Brotherhood as a terror threat. All the way back in 2017, UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan [warned that European political correctness](https://substack.com/redirect/48dc6b2d-148c-4c04-a65e-bb91270291cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) would lead to an explosion of homegrown jihadist terrorism.

If we're going to regulate AI, let's start with those companies giving aid and comfort to our enemies. Anthropic is an anti-American company that is rotten to the core.

Me and Adrian Boafo sat down last week. A lot of people found that surprising. He beat me in the Maryland 5th primary. We're still friends.
They shouldn't be surprised.
We're both from Prince George's County. We both got in this race for the same reason. We stood at the same forums in southern Maryland for six months and said basically the same things. The tactics were different. The goals weren't.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0f0801b2-bcd9-45df-97d3-b419c1146520?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What made our race ugly wasn't us. It was $12 million in outside dark money. AIPAC, AI and Crypto super PACs. Flooding a Democratic primary to elevate who they wanted in that seat. While squashing voices of people who were loud about wanting to end the system that put that money there. And here's the thing I keep coming back to: they didn't oppose us on policy. They didn't even know where we stood on policy. They came after us because we were loud about wanting to keep them out of elections forever.
Adrian won. I called him. We talked. That was it.
I wanted to sit down with him because this conversation matters more than who won. Two guys from Prince George's County who went through the same fire. The vitriol, the nasty messages, the hate. We had the same views on a lot of things: the economy is broken for regular people, the outside money is out of control, and the people yelling on the internet are not indicative of how an election is going to turn out.
Something I said in this conversation that I continue to think about: if the election was held online, I think I'd have won by 60 points. But it wasn't held online. The mother in Charles County who wakes up, gets her kids to school, goes to work, tries to figure out how to feed her family with these expensive grocery prices. She doesn't have time for the comments on social media, because she's too busy trying to make it.
That's Part 1. Parts 2 and 3 drop later this week.
[If you're not subscribed yet, do it. This is the kind of conversation I plan to keep having, and I don't want you to miss what's coming.](https://substack.com/redirect/08ed0a9f-bfa9-4cb8-b527-eec0f8f192fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
-Harry
