clean_body: A recent report puts a number on what mass deportation is costing all of us — and what citizenship would give back. | | | Peter, A new report from the AFL-CIO and the ACLU puts a number on something our communities have felt for years: mass deportations and efforts to push millions of people out of status are making life more expensive for all of us, immigrants and U.S. citizens alike. The average cost to each taxpayer is $2,358 a year. 1 That's money that should be going into your pockets so you can afford groceries, child care, housing, or even a vacation! Instead, it's being spent on detention contracts and surveillance firms that keep massive corporations rich. 😡 Over a period of twelve months ending in June 2026, the report found that mass deportations caused home healthcare costs to rise 10.7%.1 Landscaping costs were also up 10.8%. The cost of whole milk went up 9%.1 Economists estimate that mass deportations and delegalizations could wipe out 6 million jobs.1 While the administration drives up costs for working people, that same report shows what is possible when we deliver citizenship. A pathway to citizenship would mean a $4,300 raise in the first five years for millions of workers, and a $14,000 raise ten years in. 1 And let’s be clear, passing citizenship would generate hundreds of thousands of new jobs and lift wages across the board when employers can no longer use status as a threat to pay people less. ✊🏽 That's the future we're organizing for — one where all working people are treated with dignity and can enjoy safety and financial stability. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | And when we come together — union members, DACA recipients, neighbors — we make the impossible inevitable. — United We Dream * 1. Citizenship and the Affordability Agenda. AFL-CIO and ACLU. September 2026. Follow us on: | | | | |

Last week, Fox News posted the results of a survey that they had conducted. The results could not have been worse for the Republicans.
It was so bad Fox couldn't even spin it. The headline read, "Squeezed by costs, frustrated voters turn to the Democrats." Sixty-three percent of registered voters in the poll said the Trump Administration has made the economy worse.
When asked which political party would do a better job on specific issues, the Democrats led by at least ten points on Inflation and Prices (+15%), Large AI Data Centers (+14%), Corruption (+11%), and Foreign Policy (+10%). Republicans led in only one category, Immigration, and that was only by one point.
Republicans are failing, and the people have noticed.
Here in Alabama, Democrats can thank our local Republican Party for giving us the best Christmas a kid could imagine. It's as if they're trying to prove they aren't a serious party. At the top of the ticket, they have a man who is openly racist and doesn't live in the state. For Lt. Governor, they have a guy who admitted to election fraud and doesn't meet the residency requirements for the office. In an act of desperation and fear, they redrew the congressional district lines after voting had begun. Their congressional candidates are running from the public as fast as they can to avoid questions, and they don't seem able to come up with a coherent theory of governance to run on... well, except maybe "We're really MAGA," but those polls show that's not the flex it once was.

| | Moms need the courage to ask questions, seek the truth, and protect what matters most.This week on the Moms for America Podcast, three remarkable women bring three very different stories and perspectives to the conversation. Dr. Gina Loudon takes on the science and stories surrounding topics like steak, ivermectin, and even cigars, exploring information and perspectives you may not hear in mainstream media. Bailey Templeton shares a deeply disturbing experience involving the foster care system and raises important questions about how vulnerable children are protected. Then internationally acclaimed singer Cristina Fontanelli shares how music and the arts can bring healing, joy, confidence, and meaningful benefits to children. Three courageous voices. Three important conversations. Plenty for moms to consider.Because informed moms are equipped moms, and when moms speak up, families are stronger. | | Life with kids can make marriage feel like it has moved to the back burner. Between work, laundry, bills, school, activities, and sleepless nights, it can be easy to lose sight of the relationship that started it all. But your marriage matters, not only for you and your husband, but for your children. A healthy, growing marriage can provide kids with greater stability, security, and a strong foundation for their own futures. If your marriage has drifted into survival mode, don’t assume it has to stay that way. Make time to talk. Listen to each other. Apologize and forgive. Date again. Pray together. Dream together. And if you’re struggling, don’t be afraid to seek wise, professional help. Your marriage is worth the effort, and one of the greatest gifts you can give your children is a strong, loving family. Read the [full blog](https://momsforamerica.us/so/a1Q39iRLy/c?w=OFvikuwNgXdsY2EOa9JB4q3sa-7FrvzUlkXA0C_gceY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiI1MTlkNmJlYS00YjIyLTQ0OTctOTUwMS0yMDFkMjg1NzY1NTkiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ): How’s Your Marriage?

**My name is Joe Males, and I’m running for United States Congress in California’s 25th district.** [**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider donating to my campaign at the end.**](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=4c5fa7799b2142d391f3df8e4c23d23e&_e=dj6FOehniLdzWxa8CcS1rf-YbWBH71_B8dyyqqKzTSXpBtAY18Edc-6Hx3lx74SNelBmULNjedf7TnExUDurO2NdMy1hN_akDsFdOoWgBtOJ35CFs2NTAKKo3Dg9ZcAgFXedcj8ymfWeGG2yXfEHKX5iutUEsBGC3TMCO64tHGM5wsy28LRXnneKUP-5uEgYjpTrKILpXd-otmjv_90JkSTihjptD9V-Ab2VNOBU_BmnzXgAJQJnchOiTHCHTSMUhLS2Q7Je3fe5tCMlvIO7wdW-W5Ma0cQajrO9NYkQUwNk3t0ujonYNTy9Ios0-jDGAeLJDkYUQu_p1lAAWLw_mZDTM1jduE4_SodfurFZ6eB5VNetDJ6HQLMDainZM1tm1dJpMz36clYFM38OlLbgaarn2fyy4J04xdsLZLsAl8yluyj35-Q2NTbVQVCM_KzfWg7jY0WZ3roSA9I7V6Od9D1FkVR2lP_wZqfPsbEd-6-nwPcsLrqpAy6Rwp8vYW7JWB3ovUSUzzyth8KyhGlszKAqDN2BYvKxbJIjChRdik8%3D)

**WHO AM I?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=4c5fa7799b2142d391f3df8e4c23d23e&_e=dj6FOehniLdzWxa8CcS1rf-YbWBH71_B8dyyqqKzTSXpBtAY18Edc-6Hx3lx74SNelBmULNjedf7TnExUDurO2NdMy1hN_akDsFdOoWgBtOJ35CFs2NTAKKo3Dg9ZcAgejBMcgLi_3_3FxHi_qjc44v7ni7FHy7rxn0jEevmfUr01CAYh_iDA089sV9BY6lvfvDYHWzm9zs8VR-09xuDFFENvSanzq-EgFKckJ9ONP0gyPxBZT8_-Q5ZzAZYZl7lEJ_Yx1glquhz5skBNrOZJt8JiH-xTEpUBjkUkViFXqE_iruL2jz-CAGQHYCA-iW2f5gRT1JTB5Q6cJWPTit5DYSE3BKn7Ibu-rX-SvTJXRI78h8Azknc_LBWzavrsoY4uog73lo6M0osgKZTQ2AdxfPEOb4s-qVi2nNPEjspD133t9zXVL6ssD_I1Rma2o5eO0jjKTsMTl7_1l8qtaiwqLYDJCa_05B8CiK0fFkLfaSukn8Pt79wbhBFUOmAXk_EQe-BkOB94Ce0o2YoqSnQrg%3D%3D)

_Like I said, I’m Joe Males. I’m a Mexican-American who was adopted by two wonderful parents when I was four years old._

**At a young age, I joined the United States Marine Corps to defend our country and ultimately earned the rank of Sergeant before my discharge.** Once I entered civilian life, I started my entrepreneurial career owning a successful small computer business until my son took over the family business.

**Since the Democrats will want to use this to attack me, I will tell you: I was a former Democrat.** I switched over to the Republican Party during the Reagan era once I saw what the Democrats truly stood for. I’ve seen firsthand how today’s Democratic Party has abandoned working families. Every single day, I hear from constituents who are struggling with everyday challenges. I hear them, and I fully agree with them. It’s time for change in California.

**WHY DID I ENTER POLITICS?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=4c5fa7799b2142d391f3df8e4c23d23e&_e=dj6FOehniLdzWxa8CcS1rf-YbWBH71_B8dyyqqKzTSXpBtAY18Edc-6Hx3lx74SNelBmULNjedf7TnExUDurO2NdMy1hN_akDsFdOoWgBtOJ35CFs2NTAKKo3Dg9ZcAgejBMcgLi_3_3FxHi_qjc44v7ni7FHy7rxn0jEevmfUoJrTXECoFmY8-JrQcbPBrrcnkGGZRZMeG-MLqjbm35MfY1wCUw57hQ6cAYHbYMTRG0c8wmWFZ6xOapi2KYJ0maMyo80OOlF42Ft2VXJzMsuqlDijTgjwJJD_jV4h7iLgES_MMmsetyWdQo19eUoI2dS4KsPHn-HvUOGjGFRJSo6L4M1zCccQ94sIixYtQKKh8eS25s5hzLHKIuMgQ8XtCWaI1od3pBdwh1ctiOJk6WgFkrvfYA77O7w9bIC5hRKBwmiyhVCUXB8CQ5rDipQYyVuz4na-AotvtT8P58yF3zJLxhpidCEC77Dlxjdbptf-irFkUWS3ICI7X46dgUg4jpZR40b53v_j3ZV76P3h_2EA%3D%3D)

**In short, my son, Nicholas, was tragically stabbed to death and murdered in 2016.**

If you’re a parent, I’m sure you could imagine how devastating this was for me. Nicholas was only 28 at the time and did not deserve what happened.

He had followed in my footsteps and joined the Marine Corps. He was a father to two children – my grandchildren. When it happened, no one came forward with any information, and the case to find the killer went cold.

**I decided to take a stand, to fight for the rule of law and public safety so that no other family has to experience the same tragedy.** Five years later, I ran for City Council in Hemet. I won, and just a few months later, our amazing law enforcement found the killer and arrested him.

**WHAT ARE MY PRIORITIES AS YOUR NEXT CONGRESSMAN?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=4c5fa7799b2142d391f3df8e4c23d23e&_e=dj6FOehniLdzWxa8CcS1rf-YbWBH71_B8dyyqqKzTSXpBtAY18Edc-6Hx3lx74SNelBmULNjedf7TnExUDurO2NdMy1hN_akDsFdOoWgBtOJ35CFs2NTAKKo3Dg9ZcAgejBMcgLi_3_3FxHi_qjc44v7ni7FHy7rxn0jEevmfUp4M-fGO9vz46QdASWvH5xFCDtK0Sq-sLvGlIzVlsGTlv71PMHTPuu90iakacO81tudp7ysijDlYOXW56f30RU5zurdW-TNdNBtI2XrH5ComHNJa9APR3bEvc6yA6StqBT6gDi3bky1oGYSAO09ANH2ooNsZAzI9186qj5QGt0V5X0_Njz5IX1q1fF2_VKCwRbeY93iRrDJyWyxB3JVrBnOpZhajvDwNeao8kaZntDkWqLvpy70vJgO_MsdnDVkIWQB2qGxEm6gId7-yI2VkIF0O-CxululP72rToMl1yYHLb6_rhhiqSB5vpLySAvuRzLptNoaaHiYk3fwx69RLA8nOMOu24OckaVcgMEO-bS2Cg%3D%3D)

_**As a former Democrat turned Republican, I know what the Democrat Party is supposed to represent. But ever since the Reagan era, they’ve continued to move farther and farther to the extreme left. Now, they stand for DEI, wokeness, putting Americans last, and doing everything they can to fight against President Trump.**_

**As a Hispanic American who lives in a border district and who was adopted by American parents, I fully believe in LEGAL immigration.** America is THE BEST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD! Millions of people around the world want to move here for the American Dream, for the opportunity of a better life, but they must do it THE RIGHT WAY.

**Our Southern Border has been porous under Joe Biden’s Administration.** Living in a border district, I’ve seen firsthand millions of illegal immigrants entering the country with the help of the dangerous Mexican Cartel, many through my hometown, bringing dangerous drugs like fentanyl, trafficking women and children, and committing heinous crimes on our side of the border. This needs to END, and I’m grateful for President Trump’s leadership on this. In Congress, I’ll always defend strong border security.

**On top of that, I am a firm believer in the America-First Movement.** After four years under Joe Biden’s leadership, America has become weak in every aspect. I already mentioned our border security, but our military, social life, and economy have all become weakened under the rule of DEI and wokeness.

**As a military veteran, it pained me to see the way Joe Biden withdrew from Afghanistan, giving the Taliban millions of dollars worth of high-level American military equipment, which they parade around.** Our weakened military presence allowed Russia to invade Ukraine and Hamas to launch terrorist attacks on Israel. I’ll do everything in my power as a Congressman to support our military so we prioritize READINESS over WOKENESS.

**Finally, we must dismantle DEI in every corner of the government.** DOGE’s work to cut wasteful spending has been a great start, but we must continue to fight to lower the cost of living, defend free speech, and usher in the Golden Age of America.

**WHY DO I NEED YOUR HELP?** [](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=4c5fa7799b2142d391f3df8e4c23d23e&_e=dj6FOehniLdzWxa8CcS1rf-YbWBH71_B8dyyqqKzTSXpBtAY18Edc-6Hx3lx74SNelBmULNjedf7TnExUDurO2NdMy1hN_akDsFdOoWgBtOJ35CFs2NTAKKo3Dg9ZcAgejBMcgLi_3_3FxHi_qjc44v7ni7FHy7rxn0jEevmfUoq0lasPF3X-vljfAd-anSmY3zBAacnnkM0WTunkihvNOqDpbrKKvbMPVbf6rnYAemSGgS87ssP8pHFMOC88eaMxCplBMp7cbpg8-yKL9TdTeAyW121bEFskbhRO5wuHN_sSLLJYdYC0lKLjCXSxlaJ7OM_b58kVmaPsfLj8Z-1YaN7qXeTDy08unvKvu0mvhwBVX2oKiKCgNCBzlZIyar-BoDIbt4ccaUQdfBYfANlopYgkpW6bcwcfL61yunm7guKlK-Uf35PvQXMDFIUkNTSXU6GgWa8_f0wucRlw39JTbkFsUTBrUay-rbYxhiJw1UufCaHbwnv-ojty3W1OPjuQzqMC6kCjpvZvUPibUBngA%3D%3D)

**Simply put – the Radical Left has a stranglehold on California.** Just like they’re trying to flip Texas Blue, I’m trying to flip California Red. It may seem impossible, but so many Californians are sick and tired of suffering under Gavin Newsom, Nancy Pelosi, and Adam Schiff’s leadership here. I know many people who have left California just because of the politicians who want to turn our beautiful state into a Communist Utopia.

**But Newsom, Pelosi, and Schiff have MILLIONS of dollars in reserve, ready to spend against my campaign to prevent common sense leadership.** They only care about lining their own pockets, even if their constituents suffer. _It’s going to be an uphill battle, but if there’s one thing I learned as a Marine, it’s that the only way to create a better tomorrow is through dedicated hard work and grit. Together, we can fight and WIN._

## **Why Banning the Press Backfires - and How the White House** _**Should**_**Fight Back**
When President Trump announced on Truth Social last Friday that CNN, MSNOW, and Politico were barred from the White House, the media went into immediate overdrive. Within minutes, the usual talking heads were screaming about "unconstitutional attacks on press freedom" and "First Amendment violations."
[| | | | | The White House
---
@WhiteHouse
"Media Outlets shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they're covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America. Other Fake News Media Outlets to follow."
| 7:34 PM * Sep 18, 2026 * 1.07M Views9.37K Replies * 7.13K Reposts * 33.1K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/fda36dd1-c7bf-4bb0-a807-8cab115ffde1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you're a regular viewer of my show, you know I always look at these battles through two lenses: **Policy** and **Politics**.
**1\. The Policy:** There is a fundamental difference between _freedom of the press_ and _unfettered access_. The First Amendment protects these outlets' right to write and publish whatever they want without government censorship - they can still do that today. Zero restrictions have been placed on their ability to report.
Access, however is where courts draw the line. While journalists don't have an absolute right to go anywhere they want, courts have consistently ruled that White House press spaces are public access areas. I saw this firsthand during my time behind the podium. When my successor, Sarah Huckabee Sanders, revoked press passes for CNN's Jim Acosta and Playboy's Brian Karem (proof I guess there are articles), federal courts forced the White House to reinstate them. I'm no lawyer, but if I had bet where the court comes down on this, the media will likely win this round in court.
**2\. The Politics & Strategy: **I completely understand the President's frustration. The media bias against this administration isn't just obvious - it's ridiculous. And the hypocrisy is off the charts. Remember when CNN's Brian Stelter openly argued for banning Fox News? Or when the Biden administration quietly kicked out over 400 independent journalists by making the qualifications for a White House press pass out of reach for many independent journalists? The mainstream press was silent.
But banning them outright was bad strategy - especially on Friday. The President was making a massive, historic announcement in the Oval Office: all 50 states joining a groundbreaking initiative to drastically lower prescription drug costs for Medicaid. It was a huge policy victory that directly impacts millions of American families. But because of the timing of the Truth Social post right before the event, the press ignored the healthcare win entirely and focused 100% of their coverage on the media ban. The media focused on themselves, shocking I know.
Instead of giving them a courtroom battle that distracts from major victories, there are two much more effective ways to play this - and win.

In April Jon Fetherston and I visited the offices of the much-ballyhooed "Vertical Harvest" to find a ghost town, unpaid taxes, and barely a bag of micro greens.
The "urban farm" received tens of millions of dollars in taxpayer funding, both from the Biden Administration and from the State of Maine, with Maine Gov. Janet Mills even visiting the alleged salad producer for a photo op.
At the time, we peeped through the windows to see millions of dollars in equipment sitting idle, with maybe one or two bags worth of microgreens growing. (These guys could really take some lessons from the Chinese marijuana farms.)
We reported with much irony that Vertical Harvest CEO Nona Yehia told me the fantastic contraption would be "churning out salad at close to full capacity by the end of the year."
"The facility is currently churning out salad at a limited capacity," Yehia said.
Fast-forward to today: Vertical Harvest is facing foreclosure on one of the many "green" loans from the government.
Womp womp.

#### [The $50 Million Salad: Green Gurus Who Landed Biden Loan Committed Fraud, Lawsuit Claims](https://substack.com/redirect/cf82aa98-4745-4943-8b30-aa38f8b0d9c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| Apr 15
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/cf82aa98-4745-4943-8b30-aa38f8b0d9c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The entire episode is a microcosm into the Green Economy leftists and crony capitalists in the Democratic Party have created to hand out taxpayer cash, see e.g. offshore wind and community solar.
Here's Fetherston's [report](https://substack.com/redirect/89e7089d-e70f-4538-962d-ea7923bb5116?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the foreclosure filing, first reported by the Press Herald:
> An $88 million hydroponic farming project in downtown Westbrook that received tens of millions of dollars in federally backed financing, state loans and other public support is now facing foreclosure over an approximately $8.6 million clean-energy financing agreement, adding another serious financial challenge to a project the Maine Wire previously reported was operating well below its projected capacity.
> The Portland Press Herald reported Monday that Foundation Infrastructure Debt Fund I LP filed a foreclosure action last month against Vertical Harvest Maine L3C involving the company's facility at 5 Vertical Way.
> According to court records cited by the Press Herald, the foreclosure stems from a Commercial Property Assessed Clean Energy, or C-PACE, financing agreement originally entered into in December 2023 between Vertical Harvest, the City of Westbrook and Greenworks Lending LLC.
> The financing initially totaled roughly $8.25 million and was structured over 22 years at a 12 percent annual interest rate, according to the Press Herald's reporting. Greenworks later transferred its interest in the financing to Foundation Infrastructure Debt Fund, and the total financing amount was subsequently revised to approximately $8.66 million. The interest rate is scheduled to rise to 18 percent in 2028.
> Efficiency Maine has previously identified Vertical Harvest as Maine's first approved C-PACE project, saying the program facilitated more than $8 million in financing for the Westbrook facility.
> The foreclosure action seeks to enforce the C-PACE lien against Vertical Harvest's leasehold interest and improvements at the downtown property. Vertical Harvest does not own the underlying land outright.
The foreclosure action adds yet another obstacle to the Westbrook farm ever becoming a viable agricultural concern -- in addition to the other mathematically insurmountable obstacles.
In our original report, we revealed that Yehia had previously entered into a financial arrangement, separate from the C-PACE agreement, the Westbrook financing, the FAME financing, and the federal financing, in which it agreed to pay massive interest to the Canadian broker who helped secure the federal windfall.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..c9gjI8GTZnHT1ikf8ctf_-e27UVbF95B-_iATww6LZI?)
The broker subsequently sued Vertical Harvest alleging fraud.
According to the complaint, Vertical Harvest was unable to pay a two percent brokerage fee--$975,000--when the nearly $49 million federal loan closed in April 2024. Instead, the company scraped together just $75,000 at closing and deferred the remaining $900,000 into a highly punitive subordinated note.
Under that agreement with broker Waterside Commercial Finance, Vertical Harvest's debt doubled to $1.8 million by month eight and continues to accrue a 25 percent annual default interest rate.
Depending on how the subordinated note calculates interest, Vertical Harvest's obligation to its broker is increasing anywhere from $37,500 to $39,000 _per month._
That's a lot of salad!

**CONCORD, N.H.** — Opioid Lobbyist Cinde Warmington’s campaign is again [under fire](https://us.list-manage.com/SA5SYbF7FmE?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=jJJGiQ6Zzrc7_-miKp31zdWSlMt9yVrmm1QbHon8nvdk6jXA0dYxdLVA3Q==) for distributing an attack ad without the disclosures required under state law. On Monday, New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie filed a complaint against the Warmington campaign with Attorney General John Formella’s Office. [Read the letter here.](https://us.list-manage.com/jw0918VW778?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=wdeEpmJzspgLRLWwpv-yEqCvgNagQElv-eto-t0x1H12tccg3_zs6Uw_1w==)_Cinde Warmington’s embattled campaign for governor suffered another self-inflicted wound Monday after it was caught distributing an attack ad without the disclosures required under state law.__And it’s not the first time.__New Hampshire Republican Party Chairman Scott Maltzie filed an election-law complaint Monday alerting the state to the 30-second internet video, titled_[ _“Cost of Kelly”_](https://us.list-manage.com/OnZf8J6ALeI?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=3DRIOSN9KcJrdhCLnZbek4Zg_6PuJ7ebxVUNgNdFSKi2cgIwpXiWacB3CA==) _, targeting Republican Gov. Kelly Ayotte. It was posted by the “Cinde Warmington for Governor” YouTube account.__“The advertisement contains none of the required disclosures,” Maltzie wrote. “It has no paid-for statement; no identification or address of the paying candidate or political committee; no name and position of a treasurer or chairman; no clear identification of the signer’s name and address; and no aural or visual identification of the candidate who paid for the advertisement or whose advertisement was paid for by a political committee.”_ _NHJournal reviewed the video, and there were no disclaimers to be found.__Maltzie, who filed the complaint both as a New Hampshire voter and as NHGOP chairman, asked Attorney General John Formella’s office to investigate and, if it finds a violation, order the campaign to stop distributing the video until it complies with the law. The complaint also asks the state to seek a civil penalty.__A violation of RSA 664:14 can carry a civil penalty of up to $1,000. Under_[ _RSA 664:18_](https://us.list-manage.com/h2eusDDNRLO?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=C0zo8Yjdtda3D22Hy_LfzN7gFvwgKpBOqHLS7zbrB40bNZYiOds9zlTWPA==) _, the attorney general must review a written complaint and investigate when it presents sufficient evidence of a violation.__The filing is a complaint, not a finding that Warmington or her campaign violated the law.__This isn’t the first time the Warmington campaign has tripped up on the disclaimer issue.__In May, Warmington posted a billboard in Manchester attacking Ayotte that also failed to include the required language. Warmington’s campaign acknowledged the omission and said it would be corrected, according to a_[ _New Hampshire Union Leader report_](https://us.list-manage.com/sd2mJz2P6cO?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=qyyjkbzkUvJIDq-fVij_9tNjrzljsXKczQazLrSfuS2w3bQzyEHdRqR6Ng==) _.__In Monday’s complaint, Maltzie argued that the calendar mandates quick action.__“Since the election is fast approaching, prompt review and remedial action are important,” he wrote.__NHJournal has reached out to the Warmington campaign with a request for comment.__Maltzie said this latest misstep reflects the quality of the Warmington campaign as a whole.__“Although we do concede that the Warmington campaign has been an unmitigated disaster and this violation is just another day that ends in ‘y’ for them, voters deserve candidates who follow the law and a Governor that they can trust. Cinde Warmington has made it clear that she checks neither of those boxes.”_ ###

name: Deb Haaland
subject: 🌶️ do you like green chile salsa? 🌶️
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk1410-fr-nd&t=1&akid=12630%2E400544%2EC1CTMF)
---
Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. We made history by winning all 33 counties across New Mexico in the Democratic primary, officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor. I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17142?refcode=jtk1410-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12630%2E400544%2EC1CTMF)
---
This moment wouldn't be possible without the strong women who raised me and the values they passed down: work hard, care for your community, and always make room for others at the table. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community.

One of my _favorite_ New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me.

I love this recipe so much, in fact, that it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17142?refcode=jtk1410-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12630%2E400544%2EC1CTMF)
Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico.

I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand childcare, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment.
**That’s the kind of Governor I will be.**
**I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico.**
[**_Pl_** _**ease, if you believe in my vision for a brighter New Mexico, chip in $5 or whatever you can spare now to help me become the next Governor. When you click this link and donate, I'll share my own green chile salsa recipe with you! >>**_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17143?refcode=jtk1410-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12630%2E400544%2EC1CTMF)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17142?refcode=jtk1410-fr-nd&t=5&akid=12630%2E400544%2EC1CTMF)

Deb

* * *
Susan Collins' corruption has long been rumored but hard to prove. For years, she's sold herself as a 'reasonable Republican', an independent voice willing to buck her own party when it mattered most to her constituents. But she is, by all accounts, just like every other member of the Republican Party: selfish, self-interested, corrupt, and she doesn't give a damn about you.
And now, a bombshell investigation is ripping the mask off. Because the Susan Collins described in this reporting looks a hell of a lot more like the Susan Collins I've been telling you about all along.
According to ProPublica, the FBI had been building a bribery case with Susan Collins at its center. A defense contractor CEO told agents he traded campaign cash for Navy contracts. And his most important patron in Washington was - you guessed it - Susan Collins.
And let's be clear about what we're talking about here. Government contractors are prohibited from making political contributions. But trading campaign money for an official act is something even more serious: criminal bribery.
The money trail isn't a rumor. It's documented. The CEO routed $150,000 to Collins' super PAC through a shell company. Weeks later, he was telling colleagues that her office had committed to a whopping $32 million in funding for his company. You don't need me to tell you what that looks like. $150,000 goes into the political operation. Weeks later, $32 million in taxpayer money is reportedly headed toward the donor's company.
And don't let anyone tell you Collins' team was in the dark. Her super PAC chair called the shell company plan "very smart." Her campaign reached out so Collins could personally thank the donor. Having worked in this sector for over two decades, I'll tell you right now: no one picks up the phone to thank a stranger out of the kindness of their heart. They knew exactly who was paying and exactly what he wanted. At a minimum, this wasn't some anonymous check disappearing into the machinery of American campaign finance. There was a relationship here. There was access. And there was a hell of a lot of taxpayer money on the other side of it.
So what did taxpayers get for their $32 million? _Nothing_. Former employees say the research produced nothing the Navy actually wanted. One said it amounted to PowerPoint slides and a white paper. Think about that. Thirty-two million dollars of _your_ money, and the deliverable was a slide deck? Give me a break.
And then we get to the part of this story that I can't stop thinking about: Donald Trump made it all go away almost overnight. Kash Patel purged the FBI's anti-corruption squad. The Justice Department's Public Integrity Section, the unit whose entire job is investigating politicians, collapsed. And according to the reporting, this was happening just as agents were getting ready to widen the probe to lawmakers in both parties. The people whose job was to find out who in Congress was selling access were gone before the investigation could answer the question.
Here's the part that should make every Maine voter furious: this isn't ancient history Collins can wave away as something involving people who disappeared from her political orbit years ago. The people at the center of this story are still in her inner circle. Her 2026 finance director and the chair of her super PAC are the _same people_.

* * *
Susan Collins is a sitting United States senator. This is _her_ political operation. These are _her_ people. Collins sells her appropriations power to Maine voters as her greatest asset. Send me back, she says, and I'll bring the money home. She doesn't get to take credit for every dollar she brings home to Maine while pretending she bears no responsibility for what happens inside the political machine built around her.
Her defense? The FBI cleared her. But you can't be cleared by an investigation that was killed before it finished. The questions were never answered because Trump's Justice Department made sure nobody would ever get to ask them.
Our country is going through the wringer right now because we have a generation of politicians who have spent decades getting comfortable inside a political system that rewards access, money, longevity, and protecting the people already holding power. Who have been led by Donald Trump and Susan Collins, who are, in my opinion, among the most corrupt we've ever seen. And Susan Collins has been extraordinarily talented at hiding that corruption from the people of Maine and from the American people. She built herself a brand as the independent Republican, the reasonable one, the one who deserves the votes of Democrats and independents.
That brand is finished. She's exposed herself, and not just with the corruption I've laid out here. She saved Brett Kavanaugh's nomination to the Supreme Court. She let Donald Trump carry on his illegal war in Iran. And there are so many other times she's betrayed the very values she promised the people of Maine.
It's time for her to go. It's time for Donald Trump to go. And it's time for this entire generation of Republican politicians, and the other do-nothings in Washington, including a lot of people in my own party, to step aside and let the next generation take over.
It's _our_ time now.
And in Maine, voters now have a direct choice about what comes next. Collins is running for a sixth term against Troy Jackson, a fifth-generation logger and former president of the Maine Senate who has made working people, labor rights, health care, and the influence of wealthy interests central themes of his campaign.
It's time for the people of Maine to kick her to the curb and elect someone who will fight for working people in their state. That's Troy Jackson.
We need to transform this country back into a place where you can work hard and rise in the economy, where people don't go bankrupt when they get sick, where corruption isn't so rampant that it strips us of our dignity, and where our political leaders answer to us -- not to billionaires and corporate super PACs, not to people wealthy enough to buy access, but to the people they're supposed to serve. We need a country where public service _actually means_ public service.
I believe that can happen. Look at the wave we're building heading into November. If it holds, and if we can stop Republicans from buying this election or outright stealing it, we can send a powerful message and put this country a little closer to heading in the right direction. In 2028, we can elect a president who will do the same. And in 2029, we can get back to doing the people's work.
I believe we're in a strong position to do that. And we're in that position because of the brazenness and arrogance of people like Donald Trump and Susan Collins, who have been getting away with this for far too long.
Vote the bastards out.
With urgency,
-Mike

Then like, share, and keep showing up in the comments. It matters more than you know. Susan Collins' corruption has long been rumored but hard to prove. For years, she's sold herself as a 'reasonable Republican', an independent voice willing to buck her own party when it mattered most to her constituents. But she is, by all accounts, just like every other member of the Republican Party: selfish, self-interested, corrupt, and she doesn't give a damn about you. And now, a bombshell investigation is ripping the mask off. Because the Susan Collins described in this reporting looks a hell of a lot more like the Susan Collins I've been telling you about all along. According to ProPublica, the FBI had been building a bribery case with Susan Collins at its center. A defense contractor CEO told agents he traded campaign cash for Navy contracts. And his most important patron in Washington was - you guessed it - Susan Collins. And let's be clear about what we're talking about here. Government contractors are prohibited from making political contributions. But trading campaign money for an official act is something even more serious: criminal bribery. The money trail isn't a rumor. It's documented. The CEO routed $150,000 to Collins' super PAC through a shell company. Weeks later, he was telling colleagues that her office had committed to a whopping $32 million in funding for his company. You don't need me to tell you what that looks like. $150,000 goes into the political operation. Weeks later, $32 million in taxpayer money is reportedly headed toward the donor's company. And don't let anyone tell you Collins' team was in the dark. Her super PAC chair called the shell company plan "very smart." Her campaign reached out so Collins could personally thank the donor. Having worked in this sector for over two decades, I'll tell you right now: no one picks up the phone to thank a stranger out of the kindness of their heart. They knew exactly who was paying and exactly what he wanted. At a minimum, this wasn't some anonymous check disappearing into the machinery of American campaign finance. There was a relationship here. There was access. And there was a hell of a lot of taxpayer money on the other side of it. So what did taxpayers get for their $32 million? Nothing. Former employees say the research produced nothing the Navy actually wanted. One said it amounted to PowerPoint slides and a white paper. Think about that. Thirty-two million dollars of your money, and the deliverable was a slide deck? Give me a break. And then we get to the part of this story that I can't stop thinking about: Donald Trump made it all go away almost overnight. Kash Patel purged the FBI's anti-corruption squad. The Justice Department's Public Integrity Section, the unit whose entire job is investigating politicians, collapsed. And according to the reporting, this was happening just as agents were getting ready to widen the probe to lawmakers in both parties. The people whose job was to find out who in Congress was selling access were gone before the investigation could answer the question. Here's the part that should make every Maine voter furious: this isn't ancient history Collins can wave away as something involving people who disappeared from her political orbit years ago. The people at the center of this story are still in her inner circle. Her 2026 finance director and the chair of her super PAC are the same people. * Susan Collins is a sitting United States senator. This is her political operation. These are her people. Collins sells her appropriations power to Maine voters as her greatest asset. Send me back, she says, and I'll bring the money home. She doesn't get to take credit for every dollar she brings home to Maine while pretending she bears no responsibility for what happens inside the political machine built around her. Her defense? The FBI cleared her. But you can't be cleared by an investigation that was killed before it finished. The questions were never answered because Trump's Justice Department made sure nobody would ever get to ask them. Our country is going through the wringer right now because we have a generation of politicians who have spent decades getting comfortable inside a political system that rewards access, money, longevity, and protecting the people already holding power. Who have been led by Donald Trump and Susan Collins, who are, in my opinion, among the most corrupt we've ever seen. And Susan Collins has been extraordinarily talented at hiding that corruption from the people of Maine and from the American people. She built herself a brand as the independent Republican, the reasonable one, the one who deserves the votes of Democrats and independents. That brand is finished. She's exposed herself, and not just with the corruption I've laid out here. She saved Brett Kavanaugh's nomination to the Supreme Court. She let Donald Trump carry on his illegal war in Iran. And there are so many other times she's betrayed the very values she promised the people of Maine. It's time for her to go. It's time for Donald Trump to go. And it's time for this entire generation of Republican politicians, and the other do-nothings in Washington, including a lot of people in my own party, to step aside and let the next generation take over. It's our time now. And in Maine, voters now have a direct choice about what comes next. Collins is running for a sixth term against Troy Jackson, a fifth-generation logger and former president of the Maine Senate who has made working people, labor rights, health care, and the influence of wealthy interests central themes of his campaign. It's time for the people of Maine to kick her to the curb and elect someone who will fight for working people in their state. That's Troy Jackson. We need to transform this country back into a place where you can work hard and rise in the economy, where people don't go bankrupt when they get sick, where corruption isn't so rampant that it strips us of our dignity, and where our political leaders answer to us -- not to billionaires and corporate super PACs, not to people wealthy enough to buy access, but to the people they're supposed to serve. We need a country where public service actually means public service. I believe that can happen. Look at the wave we're building heading into November. If it holds, and if we can stop Republicans from buying this election or outright stealing it, we can send a powerful message and put this country a little closer to heading in the right direction. In 2028, we can elect a president who will do the same. And in 2029, we can get back to doing the people's work. I believe we're in a strong position to do that. And we're in that position because of the brazenness and arrogance of people like Donald Trump and Susan Collins, who have been getting away with this for far too long. Vote the bastards out. body:
When Isabella told the father of her baby she was pregnant, she was hoping for encouragement.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckc2unDAMhZ8m7BhlnEyABYsrIXa3aqv-LJExholuEqIkTPv4FdWM1HWX57P1Sfb5-T69o3U2bJ_Qc5_KOqU87YEL_y6ec8aN6Y5h44UfnCaQYGrZ1QATUrEPnjRWS7_QglequL82nZSdNlpW975riI0mSdiwumnQRq161ryufJtvc1vZ_vTJDuBqlFTm0t7armuVli1Rt8AqtETHqVwSx2N2ljAUzB_rnogvtPvK9fdSYhbqTcAoYNzsw4btEhPPewrnioDxmQSMdGf62I8iYMQYGV2u8VhkA8Z5ocZMQg1v38_8WYAh9BHtFoQatLoCSAHmKH7K-5GIhRpi2nNkKjZsz5HnxR5eqIE9WveE_3isj0jlxfdQOBShhh96-tLUX7-N9eshVeqX-Ms6Z7NphJbb6ft7cvnPlh49_AkAAP__PFaiUA)
---
**Friend of Life,** When Isabella told the father of her baby she was pregnant, she was hoping for encouragement. Instead, she received a single text message. **"Abort."** Already grieving the loss of her toddler's father to cancer, Isabella suddenly found herself carrying another child without the support she desperately needed. Fear quickly gave way to hopelessness, and she became convinced there was only one way out of the situation she was facing. Then something unexpected happened. Instead of making a permanent decision she could never take back, Isabella found her way to a PreBorn! Network Clinic, where she was welcomed with compassion and surrounded by people who cared about both her and her baby. They listened to her story, answered her questions, talked honestly about parenting and adoption, and shared the hope of Jesus Christ with her. As those conversations continued, our staff introduced Isabella to Cari and Christian, a couple who had spent years praying that God would bless them with the opportunity to adopt a little girl. Months later, when Isabella gave birth, she spent 80 precious hours holding her daughter before placing her into Cari and Christian's arms. Then she quietly said the words they will never forget: **"You are going to be parents to Liliana."** What Isabella didn't know was that Cari and Christian had already chosen that very name years earlier while praying for the daughter they hoped God would one day provide. Only God could write a story like that. Every day at PreBorn!, we meet women who believe their circumstances will define the rest of their lives. Time and again, God reminds us that His plans are often greater than anything we could imagine. Your generosity helps make those moments possible. A gift of **$28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound** , giving another woman the opportunity to slow down, receive compassionate care, and hear that both she and her baby are deeply loved by Jesus Christ. And because of a generous matching challenge, **every gift made before September 30 will be MATCHED dollar for dollar, up to $100,000.** Will you help another woman discover that hope is never beyond God's reach?
---

subject: What happened to Santa Clarita's Metro seat
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jason Gibbs for Congress
body:
My Column in Saturday's SCV Signal

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f6cd8566b9c7/release-jason-gibbs-launches-campaign-for-congress-in-ca-1254?e=6b22194705)

| | | | | |

Friend,
If you missed Saturday's Signal, I wrote a column about something that happened this summer. I think it says a lot about where our politics have gone.
In July, the North County cities nominated me to represent our region on the L.A. County Metro board. Metro oversees a budget of nearly $10 billion and runs one of the largest transit systems in the country. **Santa Clarita is the third largest city in Los Angeles County, and we have never had a seat at that table.** A supermajority of cities in our sector voted to send me there.
**Then members of Congress started calling mayors across Los Angeles County asking them to oppose my nomination. Not because of my record on transportation. Because of an election.**
The nomination was shut down. Most cities in attendance gave no reason at all. They simply abstained.
One mayor did speak up. Ardy Kassakhian of Glendale, who is not of my party, moved my approval anyway and condemned the campaign happening behind the scenes, even after he was pressured not to support me. He understood it would only hurt local governments trying to do what is right instead of what is politically useful.
Here is the part that bothers me most, and I said it plainly in the column: **our congressman opposed me because he does not treat decades of freeway gridlock as real, and because he believes party allegiance matters more than allegiance to community.**
I am a Republican. I have also nominated Democrats to city commissions and endorsed Democrats and independents for office. On a transportation board, the only things that should matter are mission and results, and **whether the tens of thousands of people sitting on the 5 and the 14 every morning ever get relief.**
**You can read the full column**[**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/dQijtNiEcet?e=6b22194705&c2id=28394d26250183ee20c763f216dfb633)
If it resonates with you, forward it to a neighbor. That is how this changes, one conversation at a time.
Thank you for being with us,
Jason Gibbs

Santa Clarita is the third largest city in Los Angeles County, and we have never had a seat at that table. A supermajority of cities in our sector voted to send me there. Then members of Congress started calling mayors across Los Angeles County asking them to oppose my nomination. Not because of my record on transportation. Because of an election. The nomination was shut down. Most cities in attendance gave no reason at all. They simply abstained. One mayor did speak up. Ardy Kassakhian of Glendale, who is not of my party, moved my approval anyway and condemned the campaign happening behind the scenes, even after he was pressured not to support me. He understood it would only hurt local governments trying to do what is right instead of what is politically useful. Here is the part that bothers me most, and I said it plainly in the column: our congressman opposed me because he does not treat decades of freeway gridlock as real, and because he believes party allegiance matters more than allegiance to community. I am a Republican. I have also nominated Democrats to city commissions and endorsed Democrats and independents for office. On a transportation board, the only things that should matter are mission and results, and whether the tens of thousands of people sitting on the 5 and the 14 every morning ever get relief. You can read the full column If it resonates with you, forward it to a neighbor. That is how this changes, one conversation at a time. Thank you for being with us, Jason Gibbs | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Paid for by Jason Gibbs for Congress Copyright (C) 2026 Jason Gibbs for Congress. All rights reserved.

I grew up in Milwaukee's 53206 ZIP code, where my family faced food insecurity and the threat of eviction. **I know what it feels like when the system isn't built for people like me.** That's what got me into public service in the first place. I got my start in the Wisconsin Legislature, finding common ground with people I didn't always agree with to pass laws that actually helped people. Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 units of affordable housing and push for universal childcare for working families. **I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make lives better for all Wisconsinites.** Wisconsin is one of the closest states in the country. Every one of our last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point. And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism. **That's the kind of race we're in, and we need a large coalition to defend this open seat.** **[_I'm ready for this fight, but I can't do it without support from people like you. clean_body: A kid from 53206 who built a career on bringing people together | | | | Derek, now that I'm Wisconsin's Democratic nominee for Governor, I wanted to take a minute to introduce myself properly. I grew up in Milwaukee's 53206 ZIP code, where my family faced food insecurity and the threat of eviction. I know what it feels like when the system isn't built for people like me. That's what got me into public service in the first place. I got my start in the Wisconsin Legislature, finding common ground with people I didn't always agree with to pass laws that actually helped people. Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 units of affordable housing and push for universal childcare for working families. I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make lives better for all Wisconsinites. Wisconsin is one of the closest states in the country. Every one of our last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point. And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism. Friend,Where is Greg Stanton when Arizona families needed him most?My newest ad puts Stanton’s record on trial. A record that shows Greg Stanton’s true talent isn’t legislating, but rather disappearing. During the COVID pandemic, while Arizonans were forced to close down their businesses and live in isolation, Stanton was voting from a boat in Utah, telling the rest of us to stay at home.That wasn’t a one-time slip. In seven years in Congress, Stanton has introduced dozens of bills, and only one has become law. And when life has become completely unaffordable for working Arizonans, Stanton has repeatedly fought back against cutting taxes on tips, overtime, and retirement pay. Absent when it matters, ineffective when he's there, it's an open-and-shut case, and Arizona’s Fourth District deserves better.I've spent my life showing up, as a Navy officer, as a physician treating patients, and as a small business owner meeting a payroll. I know what it means to actually be there for the people counting on you, and that's exactly the leadership I'll bring to Congress.[WATCH our new ad "Where’s Stanton?"](https://us.list-manage.com/xdXaxvdNYlx?e=6477bcd9cd&c2id=f05c70fe8231dcabc26816038b27d5aa)–Zuhdi

| The countdown has begun for the **2027 Autism Health Summit** , taking place **April 29 through May 1, 2027** , at **The Legacy Center Resort & Spa** in **San Diego, California**. name: Tim Walz
subject: A season of change
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
The leaves are falling, and so is our window to take back the House
#
Happy first day of fall, Peter!
There’s a lot of things I’m looking forward to this time of year — the start of the holiday season, spending time with family, visiting our local pumpkin patches, and enjoying the crisp weather while taking Scout on our daily walks.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260922-1.jxHpzj&amount=5&refcode=em20260922-1119&t=2&akid=1119%2E34582%2EEX5UM4)
For me, fall is a season of change. _And looking at how things are going across our country, I know we’re in desperate need of some major changes this coming November._
Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have sent our country into chaos, putting corporate donors and modern-day robber barons ahead of working families. Instead of fighting for good schools, good jobs, and affordable healthcare, they’re focused on making the big guys more powerful while leaving communities like ours behind.
But in exactly seven weeks, we have the chance to make real change: **helping Democrats take back the House and getting our country back on track.**
We need to win enough seats to flip Congress from red to blue, and I know three incredible candidates who are ready to do just that: **Jake Johnson** (MN-01), **Sarah Trone Garriott** (IO-03), and **Rachel Wallace** (PA-09).
They’re leaders who understand the everyday challenges that working families face, and they’re stepping up to make sure small towns finally have someone fighting for them in Washington.
But they need help from folks like you to get there, Peter.
**[Can you make a grassroots donation of any amount today to support Small Town PAC’s 2026 slate and power this final stretch to November 3rd?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260922-1.jxHpzj&amount=5&refcode=em20260922-1119&t=3&akid=1119%2E34582%2EEX5UM4)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260922-1.jxHpzj&amount=5&refcode=20260922-1119&t=22&akid=1119%2E34582%2EEX5UM4)**
Thank you,
Tim

We hope to have you on our team, but if you want to unsubscribe, [click here](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/amUvV7y1OUuv63ZcQ0rAzg2?unsubscribedata=160hcCG%2BNF1iJnOG7PDDEKoe3Gf6Gy5HASoKAgwCovwPfF3DsPwsBNYiIHjCdjDzDAIsRjnBgIasZk9ecskAdSvFiHdk1xcZfZYgbQUjyZXk%2FXFVOUZUsPA212SzMeIjIFRXNEcUvdPh2ztC%2BZc%2B7qjMjwQrNb7nGFeRYjv2FW4ucz0Mv6LIwm4lDYcw2VTd1KtBbl0k6FrUOaxvd3Fo9AJu2Qitzxw0wEGnZ0egP0dSd%2FZCto9izJAcM%2BTDPtay7VGBRqe0iHjm3HTHLtE5yi7bt%2BXXDgqlmOuVV4C2I89wbRnvGPoMne6NuQG%2FJXbfqtzFmNiZXaOcmWVnUcSn%2FK96acGPJjoiQpiRWYzEybeE805q5Ap7UgUrKfdDBnMSWJ3xexRB4PM3pO3uCz35d0Ja3OPj9udlEp46n9Zj620U4iO7N1kt49Kj6wLmw4As).

Peter, we need to do something about AI. Uncontrollable, highly capable frontier AI is a threat to _all of us._ It doesn’t matter if you’re a Democrat or Republican, American or Chinese. We need to set global AI rules, full stop. It’s 2026, and engineers at the world’s leading AI companies are telling us that there is a >10% chance that artificial intelligence could _kill all humans. _ They’re not mincing their words in the slightest — they are telling us it is evolving so exponentially that we could be in a doomsday scenario in a year. One year. This week, I had the opportunity to attend a briefing hosted by Senator Bernie Sanders with some of the world’s top AI experts, including the scientist known as the “Godfather of AI.” They echoed the concerns of recent whistleblowers, but they also made clear: **we still have time to act.** **We need to halt new advanced AI development. We need guardrails, transparency, and emergency powers.** We need more employees at these companies to speak out publicly, loudly, and fearlessly until everyone is forced to listen. We need the media to be covering this 24/7 until elected officials are forced to act. We need the Trump Administration to treat this with the urgency it deserves. We need the ability to shut an AI model off if there’s a credible threat to human life. The list goes on — _and we don’t even know what the full list entails because this is all happening so fast._ That’s why we need urgent, bipartisan public hearings and committees dedicated to developing and enacting solutions expeditiously. We must engage our strongest allies, such as the European Union, as well as formidable global competitors, particularly the People’s Republic of China, and lead with the creation of global rules of the road to prevent the proliferation of uncontrollable, highly capable frontier AI. **That’s why I led a coalition of more than 40 Members of Congress urging President Trump to lead global negotiations.** This isn’t partisan. We must come together for the sake of our shared humanity. This is about the safety and security of not only our nation, but nations _around the world._ In Congress, I will keep up the pressure on Mike Johnson to keep Congress in session and continually urge my colleagues across the aisle to prioritize AI regulations in our work. clean_body: | Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. | The MAGA Offers | Dear Reader,
On June 18th, an advancement to a potential Digital Dollar happened...
And most Americans didn’t even notice it.
Five federal agencies, including the Federal Reserve, proposed a rule that would tie your identity to _every_ digital dollar transaction you make.
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxmIxqglbB8IaNSfRlBSqHFgM3YRS7PrFHdaUmgfk9rJxFFZUeVc_PcT1BjqgIDUYWaNCgVE9hiSgBJv2MEAbIH0fkbQ8ur-YiR58JOlMA)

And the scary thing is...
It’s being framed as a consumer protection measure.

It always is...isn’t it?
Like back in 1971, when the dollar was cut from gold.
Americans were told it was necessary and temporary...
**And yet, 50+ years later...your dollar has never been backed by gold again.**
Now, most people will completely ignore this ruling by The Federal Reserve...
And they’ll think:
“Whatever, it’s just another regulation.”
But this is EXACTLY why it matters.
Because although this may not be the Digital Dollar itself...
**It could certainly be an advancement to a Digital Dollar.**
One in which every digital dollar is tied to an identity...
And it’ll likely get more regulated through a series of ‘harmless’ rules just like this one.
That’s why I recorded this free presentation on our **[“Digital Dollar Immunity” System](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDd9AAwAAAAAAxmIxqgnIJuQ_5SwY5B37MGBu1gf0316h2DZEhehWwoxyILJ-fKQTHptr-PbJw_RHWCujdcyJ1azbBI4Rovra7QTMDiq9GqHOi-DfVRIog)** \- allowing us to opt out of a digital dollar if it hits.

Peter, I'm in a strange spot this fall. I'm the Democratic nominee for Wake County District Attorney, and nobody filed to run against me in November. I could coast my way through November 3rd, but I'm not going to. I served in the state Senate and in Congress until the Republican legislature redrew my district. I've seen what happens when Democrats don't win up and down the ballot. In 2020, Cheri Beasley lost the race for Chief Justice of the NC Supreme Court by just 401 votes out of nearly 5.4 million. Races like that get decided by voters who fill in the top of the ticket and stop because they don't know who's running further down. That's what the Wake County Democratic Party's voter guide fixes. Volunteers will hand-deliver them to doors across the county and put them in voters' hands at the polls, so people know exactly who Democrats support in every race. That matters most in the nonpartisan races where there's no party label on the ballot: school board, soil and water, Raleigh City Council, and the ballot questions. Those races are won or lost on whether voters know who to pick. Here's the catch. The Democratic Party has to place its print order up front. Friends, For months, I’ve been talking with people across the 8th District about **Opportunity at Home: healthcare, jobs and affordability.** And one thing I hear again and again is simple: **We need to be able to get healthcare close to home.** In Silver Bay, that is about to get harder. The Aspirus Lake View Silver Bay Clinic is scheduled to close December 31. That means a roughly 60-mile round trip for care that people have been able to get in their own community. Including the residents at ther Silver Bay Veterans Home. **That’s what losing rural healthcare looks like.** It’s more time on the road. More time away from work and family. And one more reason to put off an appointment and hope the fever breaks, the pain goes away or you can manage on your own. And when a community loses healthcare, the impact doesn’t stop at the clinic door. Healthcare means jobs. It means families who shop at the hardware store, eat at the diner, volunteer in the community and send their kids to local schools. **That’s why rural healthcare matters to me.** **Congress makes choices.****

clean_body: | | | | | | Friends, For months, I’ve been talking with people across the 8th District about Opportunity at Home: healthcare, jobs and affordability. And one thing I hear again and again is simple: We need to be able to get healthcare close to home. In Silver Bay, that is about to get harder. The Aspirus Lake View Silver Bay Clinic is scheduled to close December 31. That means a roughly 60-mile round trip for care that people have been able to get in their own community. Including the residents at ther Silver Bay Veterans Home. That’s what losing rural healthcare looks like. It’s more time on the road. More time away from work and family. And one more reason to put off an appointment and hope the fever breaks, the pain goes away or you can manage on your own. And when a community loses healthcare, the impact doesn’t stop at the clinic door. Healthcare means jobs. It means families who shop at the hardware store, eat at the diner, volunteer in the community and send their kids to local schools. That’s why rural healthcare matters to me. Congress makes choices. # **Sheriff Kevin McMahill Endorses Drew Johnson for Nevada State Treasurer**

---
| |

### _McMahill cites Johnson’s commitment to accountability, fiscal discipline, and protecting taxpayers_
---
| |
**Las Vegas, NV —** Drew Johnson announced today that Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department Sheriff Kevin McMahill has endorsed his campaign for Nevada State Treasurer, citing Johnson’s commitment to responsible budgeting and protecting Nevadans’ tax dollars._“I’m proud to endorse Drew Johnson for Nevada State Treasurer. Drew understands that every dollar government spends comes from taxpayers, and he’ll bring accountability and fiscal discipline to the job. He will root out waste, protect our tax dollars, and make sure Nevada families can trust how their money is managed. As Sheriff, I know that responsible budgeting is essential to delivering the services our communities depend on. We need leaders who take that responsibility seriously, and I’m confident Drew will be that kind of Treasurer,”_ McMahill said.Johnson welcomed the endorsement, emphasizing the connection between responsible financial management and the public services Nevada families rely on._“Sheriff McMahill knows firsthand that responsible budgeting matters to the safety and well-being of our communities. I’m honored to earn his trust and support,”_ said Johnson. _“Nevadans work hard for their money, and they deserve a Treasurer who respects that. I’ll demand accountability, protect taxpayer dollars, and make sure the Treasurer’s office earns the confidence of the people we serve.”_ For more information about Drew Johnson and his campaign for Nevada State Treasurer, visit [**DrewForNevada.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/hcdJLhh4k1b?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d).

# Abbott put Texas data centers on ice until his power grid audit finishes
Texas Gov. Greg Abbott on Monday ordered environmental permits for new data centers paused until ERCOT **[finishes an audit of the existing grid-connection waitlist,](https://substack.com/redirect/e25d68bb-5730-42ba-938d-3bd1fe04ecb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e25d68bb-5730-42ba-938d-3bd1fe04ecb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)widening an August freeze.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2996d3af-633a-470d-b516-595f2f601b7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

# $100 million, five years: Binance just bet on Circle's USDC

* **Prosecutors open Iran file:** Yahoo reported Manhattan federal prosecutors and the Justice Department are investigating whether Binance allowed trading it knew violated U.S. sanctions on Iran. Binance denied it; a 2023 plea cost $4.3 billion.

# NJ crew cut a backup line. One cable. Five airports. 7,000 flights paid for it
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Monday evening that **[repaired telecom lines were letting Northeast airport operations resume](https://substack.com/redirect/bb4c1e6e-27c9-4be3-b270-e6ef8fc4238d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after a New Jersey fiber cut forced FAA ground stops.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2996d3af-633a-470d-b516-595f2f601b7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Thousands of disruptions:** Reuters, citing FlightAware, put the outage at roughly 7,000 delays and cancellations, including about 1,400 at New York City's three major airports. The cut began around 9:45 a.m.
* **Hours-long evening delays:** As of about 6:40 p.m. ET, FAA listed average delays of 306 minutes at Newark, 212 at Philadelphia, 159 at Teterboro, 72 at JFK and 67 at LaGuardia.
* **Crew blame disputed:** Duffy said **[an Amtrak construction crew accidentally cut the line.](https://substack.com/redirect/6d3657ae-a4ee-456d-a002-68a54c7e304a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Amtrak told Fox Business the work was on New Jersey Transit property and involved an NJ Transit contractor.
* **Backup fiber failed:** FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said Philadelphia TRACON lost its primary circuit; the backup revealed a broken fiber-optic cable. Duffy called the outage "not shocking."

# 75 Social Security million checks may rise 3.4% to 3.6% next year
After August CPI-W rose 3.5% year over year, AARP, CRFB and the Senior Citizens League estimated the **[2027 Social Security COLA at about 3.4% to 3.6%,](https://substack.com/redirect/6133b2b0-ecc0-4a0b-9f46-87041c78d54b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** above the 2.8% increase for 2026.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2996d3af-633a-470d-b516-595f2f601b7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Formula still needs September:** By law the COLA uses BLS CPI-W for July, August and September. The official 2027 figure follows the Oct. 14 CPI release.
* **Three shops, three prints:** CRFB estimated 3.4%, AARP 3.6% using Cleveland Fed September projections, and the Senior Citizens League 3.5%, down from 3.6% a month earlier.
* **Average check math:** TSCL said a 3.5% COLA would raise average benefits $67.90 a month, from $1,940.08 to $2,007.98.
* **Seniors ' basket differs:** TSCL executive director Shannon Benton said CPI-W tracks urban wage earners and does not represent the average senior's budget.

# After Mamdani, Florida trolled Pritzker on Chicago billboards
The Florida Chamber of Commerce put Chicago I-55 billboards **[naming Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker runner-up"Florida Economic Developer of the Year,"](https://substack.com/redirect/44f31adc-3900-4950-a619-4df6e4c88fcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/44f31adc-3900-4950-a619-4df6e4c88fcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)citing more than $2 billion in taxable income shifting to Florida.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2996d3af-633a-470d-b516-595f2f601b7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **One week on I-55:** Two billboards facing both directions on the Stevenson Expressway show Pritzker shrugging and thank him for jobs moving to Florida. They stay up for one week.
* **Migration numbers cited:** Chamber CEO Mark Wilson said Florida has grown by about 1.9 million residents while Illinois lost 75,000 or 100,000 over the same period.
* **Mamdani campaign came first:** The ads follow a Times Square push that named New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani Florida's "Economic Developer of the Year" just over a month earlier.
* **Citadel exit is exhibit:** Wilson pointed to Ken Griffin moving Citadel to Miami and said "bullet holes emerged in the Citadel building" in Chicago.

# Apple's $250 million Siri settlement just opened claims
Apple's **[$250 million class-action settlement](https://substack.com/redirect/deeb4bee-cb50-4ea6-af0a-663b7a3cc46e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over delayed Siri and Apple Intelligence features may pay eligible U.S. buyers of certain iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16 models up to $95 per device.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2996d3af-633a-470d-b516-595f2f601b7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Base payout can move:** Valid claims start at $25 per device and may be adjusted up or down to a $95 maximum depending on how many valid claims are filed.
* **Who can collect:** U.S. residents who bought an iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, or any iPhone 16 from June 10, 2024, to March 29, 2025, and expected Siri Apple Intelligence features they did not receive.
* **Deadline is Dec. 21:** Original purchasers, not resale buyers, must file by Dec. 21, 2026. Businesses may claim. A final approval hearing is set for Feb. 24, 2027, in San Jose.
* **What the lawsuit alleged:** Plaintiffs said the September 2024 iPhone 16 launch created a "clear and reasonable consumer expectation" that AI features would arrive; ChatGPT-with-Siri and an emoji tool fell short.

They stay up for one week. Migration numbers cited: Chamber CEO Mark Wilson said Florida has grown by about 1.9 million residents while Illinois lost 75,000 or 100,000 over the same period. Mamdani campaign came first: The ads follow a Times Square push that named New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani Florida's "Economic Developer of the Year" just over a month earlier. Citadel exit is exhibit: Wilson pointed to Ken Griffin moving Citadel to Miami and said "bullet holes emerged in the Citadel building" in Chicago. Who can collect: U.S. residents who bought an iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, or any iPhone 16 from June 10, 2024, to March 29, 2025, and expected Siri Apple Intelligence features they did not receive. Deadline is Dec. 21: Original purchasers, not resale buyers, must file by Dec. 21, 2026. Businesses may claim. A final approval hearing is set for Feb. 24, 2027, in San Jose. What the lawsuit alleged: Plaintiffs said the September 2024 iPhone 16 launch created a "clear and reasonable consumer expectation" that AI features would arrive; ChatGPT-with-Siri and an emoji tool fell short. subject: I'm always going to reject Socialism and the anti-American way of life

body:
lies, half-truths, innuendos, and smears...

lies, half-truths, innuendos, and

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e6822824/UaHR0cHM6Ly9vZGIubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvV1NoU2pmWTNDZQ/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjA5MjI/LbmNsckdQdTVqbw/qP2hpZHM9bmNqa1l1dnpsdVczdjBsc10/garK_fQ/s1la2ea30fe

[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily._fQ/sbt865731ed

Dear Friend who has common sense,

I'm always going to stand with America.

I'm always going to reject the extremes.

I'm always going to reject Socialism.

I'm always going to fight against the anti-American way of life.

And this has enraged a lot of people in the media, in my party, and
even former staffers --- disgruntled leakers who are viciously and
anonymously attacking me.

This is what happens when you put common sense and the wellbeing of
the people you are supposed to represent ahead of party loyalty.

But most of all, I think this is what happens when you clash with the
Socialist movement "DSA!" that is hijacking the Democratic party.

They want to...

Abolish our borders

Abolish the electoral college

Abolish Israel

Abolish the Senate and the Supreme Court (no, seriously, this is in
the "DSA!" platform)

That bad news is the "DSA!" crazies have gone from the political
fringe to controlling one of America's major political parties—and
onto ballots across the country.

The good news is the hardworking, common-sense Americans I talk to
every day still aren't buying it.

I mean, a recent Rasmussen poll kind of proves it:

71% of Americans reject socialism

67% of Democrat voters reject socialism

While 82% of Republican voters reject socialism

But here's the thing. The loudest voice in the room is often the one
that looks the most powerful.

And I've got to say, the "DSA!" voices in Washington are loud and
getting louder. The media is their megaphone.

Which is why you may be under the false impression that people really
do want the "DSA!" and their extreme policies

Nothing could be further from the truth.

I'M STANDING UP TO THEM.
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily._fQ/sbt865731ed

But sadly I'm pretty much alone on this side of the aisle.

So, can I ask you a favor?

Whatever your party affiliation is, can I ask you to stand with me
against the daily barrage of hit-pieces

IF YOU CAN DONATE JUST $25 IT WOULD BE A BIG HELP TO ME.
[https://link.email.freethinkerdaily._fQ/sbt865731ed

But it will also send a message. It will show the truth that the
"real numbers" are on our side here in Pennsylvania, as well as around
the rest of America.

You know, I recently stood in front of the iconic U.S. Steel Mill and
recorded a video talking about how my friend Dave McCormick and I
banded together with President Trump to save this facility and the
larger steel industry. But I'm not backing down.

Even though I know the media... the "DSA!"... and the party
bosses... are going to try even harder to defeat me:

"FETTERMAN DRAWS SHADOW PRIMARY FROM DEMOCRATS EAGER TO REPLACE HIM:
THE PENNSYLVANIA SENATOR HAS LONG IRKED MEMBERS OF HIS OWN PARTY" ~
BLOOMBERG

If you'll stand with me today, I know we can show them that we're not
backing down and that the real numbers are on the side of common sense
and putting our country first.

Thank you!

John Fetterman

P.S. - I'll bet you're more than a little surprised to get this email
from me. So, I want to say thanks for setting aside party affiliation
for a second and hearing me out. You see, I'm not a progressive. And
I'm definitely not a Democratic Socialist. I'm just a senator with a
big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong
borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my
constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not
to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral
College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). If you see eye-to-eye
with me, then I could sure use your help. The "DSA!" vision for
Pennsylvania and for America is not a healthy one. It is a dangerous
one.Common-sense people need to join together now to reject this
vision before it's too late. CAN I COUNT ON YOU TO STAND WITH ME
TODAY?

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: BREAKING: Fox News shifts TX-Gov race AGAIN
body:
Two rating shifts in a month have Greg Abbott terrified.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**_Fox News_ just shifted their rating of the Texas governor’s race for the second time in a month.**
Six weeks ago, _Fox News_ had our race as “Solid Republican.” Five weeks ago, they moved it to “Likely Republican.” And today, they are grading our race as “Lean Republican.”
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260922_2_powerrankings.3ooRPL&refcode=em20260922-2193&amount=5&t=1&akid=2193%2E299639%2EBQc3NF)
Fox wrote that Texas is “drifting away” from the GOP. They’ve woken up to what our campaign has known for months: Texans are ready for change, and they’re ready for an end to Greg Abbott’s corruption.
Greg Abbott has spent this campaign defending data center deals that are driving up electricity costs and water use across the state, while our campaign is holding him accountable.
Yesterday, with the race clearly tightening, Abbott hit the panic button — halting new data center construction until at least December, _after the election._
